 Translate high level design and business requirements into system solutions and implement in alignment with the design and architectural standards, while meeting quality, performance and security requirements. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Business process understanding and driving business stakeholders alignment. Develop system designs that adhere to high level conceptual design and are traceable to functional as well as non-functional requirements in projects/enhancements Ensure designs produced adhere to architectural roadmap and support the development, execution and operations of solutions Deliver design solutions in line with system design standards which are global and scalable following a global template philosophy (Core/Template) Ensure that solutions meet requirements outlined in the architecture handbook Perform scoping, fit-gap workshops for projects/enhancements, proposes solutions for key gaps, provide effort estimations and align with business teams Ensure that project/enhancements work is delivered to agreed time, cost and quality constraints following the release calendars Ensure that developed solutions are peer reviewed, formally documented and signed off by business Initiate solution testing to ensure these meet quality standards Follow standardized design and development processes to enable cost effective delivery Take accountability to ensure adherence with Security and Compliance policies and procedures within Solution Design scope. 
 
 Key Performance Indicators/Measures of Success 
 Solution Quality; Cost efficiency; Delivery time; Customer Satisfaction; Achievement of KPIs for enhancements Global responsibility for SAP design, upgrade, maintenance and Support of the Direct and Indirect Procurement functions with interaction with Accounts Payable and TE management from IT perspective Providing governance and maintenance to the Global Source-to-pay template with AP and TE functionalities Providing SME level support for the AMS team on Production Support incidents and Enhancement requests 
 
 Influence 
 Maintaining and updating global procurement template design for SAP with other strategic programs and projects influencing: IT stakeholders - Business Techlogy Partners (BTP) and Global Process Owner(GPO) community Application Maintenance Services (AMS) team 
 
 Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications 
 University degree or adequate equivalent Bachelor degree in business/technical stream and SAP knowledge in specified module(s)/process areas. At least 6 to 8 years experience in IT/business consultancy with SAP implementation in an international environment. Prior experience in working with small - Mid size teams needed. Team leading capability will be an added advantage. Proven experience in SAP S4 HANA/ECC implementations, detailed process analysis and design, system architecture and technology standards. S4 experiences will be preferred. Proven experience in understanding SAP functionality, related business processes, master and transactional data structures in the area of responsibility. Deep knowledge in SAP Ariba latest generation products, their architecture with backend connectivity will be preferred. Working level knowledge in SAP Invoicing and Concur TE system will be preferred. Web integration methodology, data acquisition frameworks and analytics will be appreciated. Willingness to travel - Less than 25% (based on business need). Direct impact on strategic SAP programs and projects to deliver Business IT strategy under guidance and supervision of ESA - FP leadership. 
 
 Competency Profile 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills Able to leverage networks of professionals across functions and business areas Understands the competing organizational needs beyond own part of business Able to interpret complex information and to influence internal and external peers Demonstration of Alcon value and behaviors within the own organization with ability to motivate and energize others. 
 
 Specific Professional Competencies 
 Proven Hands-on experience and expert level knowledge in SAP S4 HANA/ECC ERP and Cloud technology Functional domains in some/all of the following areas in order to be able to support current and future Alcon business processes: SAP On-promise and cloud Direct Purchasing (MM-PUR) Indirect Purchasing (SAP Ariba Upstream/BI/P2O) Commerce Automation, Supply Chain Collaboration and related functions via SAP Business Network Invoicing and Accounts Payables (MM-LIV) SAP Concur TE system Preferable knowledge in the following areas Vendor Invoices Management (VIM) Cloud based invoicing solutions like Appzen, Open Text etc. Other related cloud based platforms facilitating specialized services for Procurement like Risk evaluation, Market Intelligence etc. Working experience with integration of various alien systems (SAP or non-SAP) to SAP-ERP through some form of middleware (e.g. CPI/SI/Mulesoft) required Basic technical competencies like IDOC, XML, JSON monitoring, RfC connectivity, ALE distribution model, Different type of WRICEF objects and their usage depending on functional need etc. required Excellent understanding of the master data settings such as Materials / Vendors / Customers / Business Partners/Info-records/Source List/Quota Arrangements etc. supporting the areas mentioned above is a must Good understanding of Life Sciences/Pharma/Medical devices and/or contact lenses industry along with FDA Computer System Validation processes is an advantage

title: Principal II, IT Business Systems Analysis (T)
description:
Job Summary The Senior IT Business Analyst will play a key role in bridging the gap between IT and business stakeholders. This role focuses on Salesforce.com development and requires experience in UX/UI design. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of IT systems and business processes, and the ability to translate complex business practices into actionable technical requirements. This position will act as a liaison between the development team and business product owners, providing subject matter expertise on business processes when the product owner is not available. Key Responsibilities Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with business product owners and subject matter experts to gather and document business requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Act as the business process expert for Salesforce.com, providing insights and clarifications to enhance the integration and utilization of Salesforce.com solutions. Solution Design Integration: Work closely with development teams to ensure IT solutions meet business requirements. Act as a liaison to facilitate communication, ensuring that functionalities are aligned with business needs and integrated effectively with other IT systems. Provide guidance and clarification on Salesforce.com functionalities and requirements to both the development team and business stakeholders. UX/UI Design: Lead the UX/UI design process for IT solutions, creating intuitive and effective user interfaces. Experience with Figma is preferred but not required. Systems Specifications: Develop and configure system specifications to address business requirements and fit with the companys system architecture standards, including Salesforce.com. Compliance Standards: Ensure that software compliance standards are met and that Salesforce.com solutions adhere to these standards. System Interfaces: Evaluate interfaces between systems and operational requirements, including how Salesforce.com integrates with other systems. System Parameters: Establish and document system parameters and formats, ensuring system compatibility with Salesforce.com and coordinating modifications as needed. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization and implement best practices to streamline operations and improve service delivery. Ensure that Salesforce.com processes are aligned with these improvements. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including business requirements, process flows, system specifications, and design mockups related to Salesforce.com and other IT solutions. Liaison Role: Act as a liaison between the development team and business product owners to ensure smooth communication and resolution of issues. Provide subject matter expertise on business processes and Salesforce.com when needed. Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications Total of 7-10 years of experience with Bachelor s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. Advanced degree or relevant certification (e.g., CBAP, PMP, Scrum Master) is a plus. Minimum of 5 years of experience as an IT Business systems Analyst or similar role, with a proven track record of successful project delivery. Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in an Agile environment. Extensive experience with Salesforce.com development and customization, including system specifications and integration. (Process management Exp, process mapping, data flow, requirement gathering) Proficiency in UX/UI design, with Figma experience preferred. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders. Proficiency in business analysis tools and techniques, such as process mapping, use case development, and requirements elicitation. Familiarity with IT systems, software development lifecycle (SDLC), and project management methodologies. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work. Preferred Skills Experience with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI). Knowledge of industry-specific software and systems. Experience with change management and training initiatives. Work Hours 1 PM to 10 PM IST Relocation Assistance Yes

description:
GLO- Sourcing Rate Analyst This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. This role is a critical role within the Global Logistics Spares Supply Chain Sourcing (GLSS) organization, primarily responsible for the management and governance of Service Parts, Electronic Commodities Pricing and to some extent Logistics modes pricing across a Global Supply Chain network. The analyst will manage pricing validations , cost impact assessments , inventory valuation activities, supplier pricing changes , Customer Back Order and metrics reporting to ensure compliance with financial policies, cost integrity and operational excellence. 
 In addition to pricing ownership, this individual will play a key role in supporting HPE s strategic transformation initiatives, including automation, Process governance, analytics enablement and AI-driven solutions. 
 
 What You Will Do 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Spares commodity Services Pricing Manage end-to-end pricing governance for service parts and spare commodities Execute pricing reviews, validations, and approval processes for new product introductions and existing portfolio updates. Perform pricing impact assessments, PPV analysis, and profitability evaluations. Analyze supplier cost changes and recommend pricing actions based on business and financial impacts. Support inventory valuation activities and pricing-related financial reviews. Ensure Pricing accuracy and integrity across ERP, planning, and operational systems. Investigate pricing discrepancies and implement preventive actions through root cause analysis. Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Planning, Operations, Finance, and Product teams to align pricing strategies. 
 Transformation and Continuous Improvements Support logistics transformation programs, pricing automation initiatives, and continuous improvement projects across logistics and Spares. Collaborate with sourcing, finance, operations, and technology teams to improve pricing processes and business metrics. Participate in process redesign, standardization, automation, and AI-driven transformation projects. Contribute to development of future-state pricing and rate management capabilities. 
 Other Analytics Financial Controls Develop pricing and rate management dashboards using Excel and /or other analytics tools. Perform spend analysis and identify cost leakage risks and optimization opportunities. Own customer backorder (BO) reporting, data analysis, and operational performance visibility. Track and report key business KPIs and pricing performance metrics. 
 What You Need to Bring Expertise in one or more of the following areas : Service Parts or Spares Pricing Product Costing Strategic Sourcing Commodity management Procurement / Strategic Sourcing Experience Level: 5- 7 years, preferably with backgrounds from High Tech, Electronics Manufacturing, IT Hardware, Procurement Analytics or Commodity Management. 
 Education: Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain Operations, Statistics or related field or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree preferred

title: Internal Auditor -Business Operations
description:
Internal Auditor -Business Operations Description - Job Summary 
 The Auditor applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues within established guidelines and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May provide direction to team activities and facilitate information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment within generally defined policies and practices to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle unique situations. Consults leads and managers to make decisions on complex business issues. This role is responsible for assessing systems and processes, identifying key risks and internal controls, conducting tests, documenting findings, and proposing recommendations for designated areas. The role excels in interviewing to gather insights about business processes and inherent risks. The role evaluates and suggests audit approaches, engages in research, shares analytical insights, and provides progress updates. The role also analyzes audit data, fosters positive relationships, assesses technology integration, solves complex problems, and may lead simple projects or parts of projects while delivering reports and supporting operational plans. 
 
 Responsibilities Executes independently with minimal support and direction. Performs all audit activities that involve identifying inherent and residual risks and helps conduct risk-based assurance and advisory projects. Responsible for reviewing internal controls, conducting test work, documenting standard operating procedures and findings, and drafting recommendations for assigned areas. Completes all the job tasks within the defined timelines, anticipating and addressing conflicts or dependencies in a complex setting, and monitoring and communicating progress. Effectively conducts interviews to gather information about HP business processes and associated risks. Reviews and recommends audit approaches and tools to use during assurance and advisory engagements. Works towards enhancing the current audit methodologies, internal controls, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining intended results. Can identify key performance indicators and opportunities for continuous control monitoring. Able to design a complex audit work program effectively that is sufficient for re-performance with limited input from the manager. Actively researches, shares analysis, and provides regular updates on project accomplishments and impediments. Analyzes audit data and provides formally written audit results reports and recommendations to management. Able to clearly document issues, assess impacts, and determine root causes. Able to explain input and output of systems and processes and understands how to assess the risks associated with inputs and processing. Stays abreast of industry knowledge and HP IA environment, new audit developments, policies and standards, systems and applications used, benchmarks, emerging risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, fraud) and trends in audit scope. Applies knowledge of automation and process improvement, including the use of AI-enabled methodologies. Provides subject matter support and supervises beginner auditors in specific audit areas. Assists team in developing technical and professional competencies. Able to express and explain complex audits. Keeps pace with technical and operational innovation and change. Demonstrates positive relationships with auditees, peers, and the stakeholders. Ensures confidentiality and always maintains professional demeanor. 
 Education Experience Recommended 
 - Four-year or Graduate Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or similar discipline 
 - Typically has 4+ years of relevant work experience, preferably in audit or compliance roles, and public accounting experience is recommended 
 
 Preferred Certifications 
 - Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) 
 - Certified Public Accountant (CPA) - Chartered Accountant (CA) - Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) 
 - Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA)

 Procurement / Supply Chain Function 
 Raw Material Procurement – Solar Cells Position 
 Sr. Manager – Procurement Category 
 RM Category A – Solar Cells Location 
 As per business requirement Reporting To 
 Head / GM – Procurement & Supply Chain A. JOB OBJECTIVE To manage end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) activities for RM Category A – Solar Cells, ensuring uninterrupted material availability, competitive sourcing, timely procurement, effective supplier management, and delivery as per production and business requirements. The role will drive strategic vendor development, cost optimization, supplier performance, process improvements, and cross-functional coordination to strengthen supply reliability and overall procurement effectiveness. B. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own end-to-end P2P procurement for Solar Cells, covering supply planning, sourcing, purchase requisition, PO processing, approval coordination, logistics, delivery planning, and closure. Develop and execute procurement plans aligned with production schedules, sales commitments, inventory norms, and business demand. Manage strategic suppliers and ensure timely availability of Solar Cells as per quantity, quality, specification, price, and delivery requirements. Lead vendor onboarding, qualification, evaluation, development, and periodic performance reviews for strategic suppliers. Build and maintain long-term supplier partnerships to ensure continuity of supply, commercial competitiveness, and responsive support during demand fluctuations. Drive commercial negotiations covering price, payment terms, credit period, MOQ, lead time, freight, warranty/claims, and other contractual terms. Coordinate PO creation, amendments, approvals, order confirmation, and follow-up to ensure timely execution. Coordinate LC opening, approval, amendment, and closure with Finance/Treasury and relevant internal stakeholders, wherever applicable. Plan and coordinate inbound logistics, shipment schedules, documentation, customs/clearing coordination, and delivery to ensure material reaches the plant within required timelines. Monitor supplier order fulfilment, shipment status, inventory pipeline, and potential supply risks; initiate corrective actions and escalation where required. Track supplier OTIF performance, lead time, quality issues, shortages, claims, and commercial deviations through defined KPIs and dashboards. Identify alternate suppliers and develop contingency plans for critical materials to mitigate supply disruption and business continuity risks. Drive cost optimization through strategic sourcing, price benchmarking, volume consolidation, negotiation, alternate sourcing, and value-engineering opportunities. Collaborate with Production, Planning, Quality, Finance, Logistics, Stores, Engineering, and other stakeholders to resolve procurement and supply-related issues. Ensure procurement transactions and documentation comply with company policies, approval matrices, audit requirements, and applicable statutory/commercial guidelines. Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, standardization, and process improvement across the procurement cycle. Prepare and present procurement MIS, spend analysis, supplier performance, savings, open PO, delivery, inventory pipeline, and risk reports to management. Support annual budgeting, procurement strategy, supplier capacity planning, and long-term sourcing initiatives for Solar Cell requirements. C. STRATEGIC / VALUE-ADD RESPONSIBILITIES Develop category strategy for Solar Cells based on demand outlook, supplier landscape, capacity, pricing trends, technology changes, and supply risk. Build a robust supplier ecosystem with focus on reliability, scalability, quality, cost competitiveness, and business continuity. Lead supplier development initiatives to improve delivery adherence, responsiveness, quality, and overall supplier capability. Drive should-cost analysis, market intelligence, benchmark studies, and commercial analytics to support sourcing decisions. Identify and implement procurement savings and working-capital improvement initiatives without compromising supply continuity or quality. Establish risk-monitoring mechanisms for critical suppliers, including capacity, financial/commercial, logistics, geopolitical, and supply-chain risks. D. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Material availability / supply continuity Supplier OTIF and delivery adherence Procurement cost savings and cost avoidance Purchase price variance / price competitiveness Inventory and working-capital optimization Supplier quality and complaint closure PO and LC processing turnaround time Supplier onboarding and development effectiveness Critical supply risk mitigation Process compliance, audit readiness, and procurement cycle-time improvement E. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commerce, or a related discipline; MBA / PG qualification in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, or related field preferred. Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in Procurement / Strategic Sourcing / Supply Chain, preferably in Solar, Renewable Energy, Electronics, Electrical, Semiconductor, Manufacturing, or a related industry. Strong experience in strategic procurement and end-to-end P2P operations, preferably handling critical / high-value raw material categories. Experience in Solar Cell procurement, supplier ecosystem, international sourcing, LC-based transactions, and inbound logistics will be an advantage. F. CORE COMPETENCIES Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Supplier Relationship & Vendor Development Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimization P2P / Procurement Process Management Supply Planning & Material Availability Logistics & Delivery Management LC / Trade Finance Coordination Supplier Risk & Performance Management Data Analysis, MIS & Procurement Dashboards Cross-functional Stakeholder Management Problem Solving, Decision Making & Process Improvement G. SYSTEMS / TOOLS Hands-on experience with ERP procurement modules such as Oracle / SAP or equivalent. Strong proficiency in MS Excel, data analysis, procurement dashboards, and reporting tools. Working knowledge of procurement analytics, supplier performance tracking, and digital sourcing tools. H. STAKEHOLDER INTERFACES Internal: Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, Planning, Quality, Finance, Treasury, Logistics, Stores, Engineering, Legal, and senior management. External: Strategic suppliers, manufacturers, logistics partners, freight forwarders, banks/trade-finance partners, and other supply-chain service providers. I. ROLE PROFILE The position requires strong ownership of critical raw material procurement, commercial acumen, supplier-management capability, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and time-sensitive supply requirements in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

title: Business Analyst - SAP Finance
description:
Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Business Analyst III - SAP FICO DESCRIPTION As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world s toughest challenges. Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science. As a Business Analyst III - SAP FICO , you will serve as a functional subject matter expert for SAP Finance and Controlling solutions and help bridge business needs with scalable, sustainable technology solutions. You will partner with Finance stakeholders, IT teams, and technical teams across our global organization to understand business requirements, analyze processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and design solutions supporting Finance and Controlling business processes. You will lead functional activities for projects, enhancements, and system changes throughout the solution lifecycle-from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization. You will also support complex production issues, drive continuous improvement, and ensure effective integration between SAP FICO and other SAP modules and enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities Serve as a functional subject matter expert for SAP Finance and Controlling processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and related financial processes. Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify process and system gaps, and translate business needs into scalable SAP solutions. Design and configure SAP FICO solutions aligned with business requirements, enterprise standards, and SAP best practices. Lead functional design activities for assigned projects, enhancements, and system changes. Evaluate solution alternatives and provide recommendations considering business value, system impact, scalability, supportability, controls, and integration dependencies. Develop detailed functional specifications for enhancements, interfaces, reports, conversions, workflows, and other technical developments. Provide functional leadership for integration between SAP FICO and other SAP modules, including Sales and Distribution (SD), Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), and related enterprise applications. Support Finance integration with upstream and downstream applications and processes, including interfaces, data flows, and financial postings. Lead functional analysis and resolution of complex production issues, including root-cause analysis, solution development, testing, and implementation. Coordinate with developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, Finance users, business teams, and external partners to resolve cross-functional and technical issues. Lead or coordinate functional activities across the system development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, system configuration, unit and integration testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, data migration and validation, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Develop and review functional and system documentation, including functional specifications, configuration documentation, process documentation, test scenarios and scripts, cutover documentation, and user support materials. Provide Level 2/Level 3 functional support for SAP FICO applications and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests. Identify and drive opportunities for process simplification, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement. Assess the impact of proposed system changes across Finance processes, SAP modules, interfaces, controls, and downstream applications. Support SAP upgrades, S/4HANA initiatives, global template deployments, and transformation programs as required. Work effectively with global and cross-functional teams to deliver solutions across different business units and geographies. Provide functional guidance and knowledge sharing to junior analysts, support teams, and business users. Ensure solutions and changes follow established IT governance, security, change management, documentation, quality, and compliance standards. REQUIREMENTS Advanced Degree plus 3 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor s Degree plus 5 years of relevant experience in Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Typically 5-8 years of relevant SAP FICO functional experience, including implementation, rollout, enhancement, and production support experience. Strong hands-on experience with SAP Finance and Controlling configuration and end-to-end financial processes. Strong functional knowledge of core SAP FICO capabilities, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and financial closing processes. Strong understanding of integration between SAP FICO and other SAP modules, particularly SD, MM, and PP. Experience developing functional specifications and working closely with ABAP developers, integration teams, and other technical resources. Experience leading functional activities through requirements, design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support. Experience troubleshooting complex SAP functional and integration issues and performing root-cause analysis. Experience with at least one full-cycle SAP implementation, major rollout, or transformation program. Experience with data migration, interfaces, reporting, and integration technologies such as IDocs, file transfers, web services, and APIs. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to facilitate requirements, solution design, and problem-solving discussions with business and technical teams. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Ability to independently manage complex functional assignments, priorities, and deliverables. Ability to build consensus and work effectively across functions, business units, and global teams. Strong documentation, organizational, presentation, and facilitation skills. Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar application lifecycle and service management tools. Ability to manage shifting priorities in a results-oriented global environment. Preferred Qualifications Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling. Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, or transformation programs. Experience working with global SAP templates and global Finance processes. Knowledge of S/4HANA capabilities and changes relevant to Finance and Controlling. Experience with global financial processes, financial close, intercompany transactions, and integration across business processes. Knowledge of IDocs, interfaces, APIs, and basic SAP debugging concepts. Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or other structured project delivery methodologies. SAP certification in Finance, S/4HANA Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, or a related area is preferred. Experience supporting process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Willingness to travel as needed.

title: SAP Business Transformation Management Consultant (SAP BTM)

The role is centred on SAP LeanIX and SAP Signavio . SAP LeanIX will be the primary platform for enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, landscape transparency, repository governance and transformation insights. SAP Signavio will be the primary platform for process modelling, process governance, process intelligence and fit-to-standard support. Together, these tools will help connect applications, capabilities, processes, initiatives and transformation outcomes. 
 Role & responsibilities SAP LeanIX and Enterprise Architecture Management Act as a hands-on delivery partner for SAP LeanIX, supporting application portfolio management, enterprise architecture management, repository governance and transformation insight. Improve the reliability, completeness and usability of LeanIX data through profiling, cleansing, validation, ownership follow-up and recurring data-quality controls. Support fact-sheet onboarding, ownership assignment, lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, business-capability mapping, technology mapping, interface visibility and initiative linkage. Produce dashboards and portfolio insights covering application ownership, lifecycle, technology risk, rationalisation, obsolescence, transformation impact, adoption and data-quality trends. Support application portfolio assessment, modernisation and rationalisation by translating repository data into clear options, risks and recommended actions. Strengthen the integration between SAP LeanIX and ServiceNow to improve alignment between enterprise architecture, CSDM 5.0 concepts, CMDB structures, service ownership and operational technology data. Help evolve LeanIX from an APM repository into a broader EAM platform supporting roadmaps, standards, transformation planning, AI inventory and architecture governance. SAP Signavio and Process Transformation Support SAP Signavio as the digital process foundation for transformation, including process modelling, process governance, fit-to-standard support, process ownership and continuous improvement. Work with Process Owners, Product Owners, architects and programme teams to connect business processes to approved applications, business capabilities, initiatives and ERP transformation milestones. Facilitate structured process discovery and improvement activities; document decisions, dependencies and follow-up actions. Apply process intelligence and process-mining concepts to identify variants, bottlenecks, control gaps and improvement opportunities where suitable data is available. Translate process insight into implications for application portfolios, architecture roadmaps, programme design and transformation governance. BTM Toolchain, WalkMe Incubation and SAP Cloud ALM Collaboration Contribute to a joined-up BTM operating model across SAP LeanIX, SAP Signavio and, over time, WalkMe, with a focus on reusable practices across SAP and non-SAP ERP programmes. Build working knowledge of WalkMe and digital adoption principles to support future incubation, including user journeys, in-application guidance opportunities, adoption analytics and change enablement. Partner with the SAP Cloud ALM specialist to align process, architecture and delivery information, including traceability between process design, requirements, testing, deployment and transformation milestones. Support common identifiers, ownership rules, data mappings, synchronisation controls and reconciliation practices across the transformation toolchain. Explore innovation opportunities across an agentic BTM toolchain, including automation patterns, AI-assisted analysis, MCP server concepts, headless paradigms and reusable orchestration between architecture, process and delivery data. 
 Preferred candidate profile 6+ Years of Relevant experience in enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, business process transformation, SAP or ERP transformation, IT governance, data governance or consulting. Hands-on experience with SAP LeanIX, another recognised enterprise architecture platform, or a substantial architecture repository implementation. Experience improving architecture, portfolio or process data through profiling, cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, ownership engagement and repeatable governance controls. Experience with application portfolio assessment, rationalisation, lifecycle management, technology-risk analysis or transformation roadmap support. Working experience with business process modelling, process governance or process improvement; exposure to SAP Signavio, BPMN 2.0 or process mining is strongly preferred. Experience producing dashboards, reports or portfolio insights and translating data into decisions, recommendations and prioritised actions. Exposure to SAP S/4HANA or broader ERP transformation programmes is desirable, including non-SAP ERP environments. Exposure to APIs, enterprise-system synchronisation and LeanIX integration with ServiceNow, with basic understanding of CSDM 5.0, CMDB principles and service modelling. Demonstrated curiosity and practical experimentation with automation, AI-enabled ways of working, agentic concepts or integration patterns that improve speed, quality and reuse. Experience working in global, matrixed or GCC delivery environments is essential.

SAP Certified Process Management Consultant – SAP Signavio, desirable. SAP Certified – Process Data Analyst – SAP Signavio, desirable for candidates with a process-mining emphasis. SAP Certified – Solution Transformation Consultant with SAP Cloud ALM, desirable but not core. SAP Certified – WalkMe Digital Adoption Consultant, future-facing advantage. TOGAF, ArchiMate, BPMN, Lean/Six Sigma, SAP Activate or recognised change-management qualifications are advantageous.

title: Supervisor, SAM & CLH
description:
The Software Asset CLH Analyst III is the shift lead and technical anchor for one of the three IST-anchored shifts. The role carries two things at once: operational command of the shift - queue ownership, escalation resolution, and the handover into the next window - and the deepest technical expertise on the team, covering Corporate License Hosting server operations and the high-risk legal and contractual gating that junior levels are not authorised to clear. On the CLH side the analyst monitors the health of the global floating-licence servers, raises and validates licence file changes when contracts renew or quantities change, reads concurrent-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor, and works daemon drops to resolution inside the 4-hour SLA. On the governance side the analyst handles EULA and clickwrap reviews, checks the master review register before re-reviewing, routes signed agreements out of the standard queue and into formal legal cases, and supports publisher relationships and business reviews. Three of these roles exist, one per shift, and each is the senior decision-maker on duty when the manager is off the clock. CORE COMPETENCIES EXPERTISE To maintain operational excellence, analysts must demonstrate proficiency in the following key domains: Foundational Licensing Knowledge: Deep understanding of perpetual, subscription, SaaS, and true-up models, including their unique compliance implications and operational requirements. Corporate License Hosting (CLH) Expertise: Advanced capability in managing floating-license servers, editing configuration files, working daemon drops within SLAs, and analyzing concurrent usage metrics via the Altair Floating License Monitor. Governance Risk Management: Authority to manage high-risk EULA/clickwrap reviews, check master review registers, and enforce the prohibition on signed agreements within standard queues by routing them to formal legal channels. Compliance Audit Proficiency: Mastery in constructing Initial and Final License Positions (ELP) by reconciling entitlement against usage evidence, and supporting publisher business reviews. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Shift Leadership Escalation Ownership Own the shift: allocate work across the Level III, Level II and Level I analysts on duty, hold turnaround targets, and act as the senior decision-maker on the floor. Take and resolve escalations - customer complaints, blocked provisioning, entitlement disputes and licence failures - and judge correctly what must go to the ESAM Manager or the client rather than be absorbed. Run a clean handover into the next shift: open escalations, at-risk items and in-flight approvals documented and explicitly accepted, so nothing stalls in the gap. Mentor Level II analysts, review their complex casework, and build the bench for shift-lead cover. Monitor the portal and ticket queues for the shift, keeping ticket hygiene and category coding correct so reporting downstream is trustworthy. 2. Corporate License Hosting (CLH) Server Operations Monitor the health of the global licence servers hosting concurrent and floating licences, working daemon drops and service failures to resolution within the 4-hour critical SLA. Raise and validate Licence File Change requests on contract renewal, quantity change or expiry, editing the flat text configuration files on the hosting servers correctly and reversibly. Read concurrent checkout and peak-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor - logging in strictly as a guest, and never entering corporate credentials without explicit system-administrator approval. Assess new hosting requests against the CLH eligibility criteria: native floating/concurrent licence support, Windows or Linux server compatibility, a supported server daemon (FlexNet preferred, others subject to compatibility review), no geolocation or policy usage restrictions, and an active informative catalogue item for user instructions. Apply the CLH request-routing matrix on unlisted floating-licence requests - checking the hosted-titles list, brokering spare capacity with the product champion and support owner on publicly shared pools, bypassing pool sharing on private pools, and capturing destination MAC addresses where a requester declines server hosting. Manage decommissioning: raise the support request to retire the daemon and remove licence files from the server when a hosted product is withdrawn. 3. High-Risk Legal, EULA Contract Gating Own high-risk EULA and clickwrap review on the shift - copying non-signed agreements to secure storage and checking the master reviews register to confirm whether an approved review already exists within the last three years before triggering a new one. Enforce the signed-agreement prohibition: signed agreements are never accepted through the standard unlisted queue and must be routed via the contract intake path to be managed as formal legal cases. Identify and reject out-of-scope use cases on sight - code to be incorporated into customer-facing products, personal devices, and reverse engineering - using the standard responses and correct onward routing. Coordinate vendor security assessments and legal-review pipelines, and track the cases needing director-level signature through to execution by the clients signatory. The team never signs. Support the renewal milestone schedule as the technical owner of licence position - building the Initial and Final Licence Positions from usage scans and consumption snapshots. 4. Publisher Governance, Audits Continuous Improvement Support publisher relationships and coordinate Semi-Annual Business Review inputs - performance data, utilisation evidence and action tracking - for the publishers in scope. Run the shifts weekly and monthly licence audits, and own the accuracy of savings and cost-avoidance entries in the licence-reclaim audit table. Identify automation candidates and author Business Requirements Documents where a publisher crosses 1,000 transactions a year, moving work onto robotic process automation or vendor APIs. Own the technical escalation path into publishers and resellers for entitlement, key and activation failures the shift cannot resolve. Maintain and improve SOPs for the technical procedures on the shift, so CLH work is repeatable rather than resident in one persons head. PERFORMANCE SERVICE LEVELS Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift. CLH Critical Response: resolve or contain critical Corporate License Hosting issues - daemon drops, server unavailability, checkout failures - within the 4-hour SLA. Shift SLA Attainment: hold the shifts queues to the committed targets, with listed software inside 3 days and standard SaaS provisioning inside 1 day. Escalation Resolution: own every escalation raised on the shift to closure or explicit handover, with no silent ageing. Handover Completeness: 100% of shifts closed with a documented, accepted handover. Legal Authority Compliance: zero signed agreements processed through the unlisted queue; zero agreements signed by the team; 100% register check before a new legal review is raised. Licence Position Accuracy: Initial and Final Licence Positions delivered on the milestone dates and reconcilable to usage evidence. Audit Savings Integrity: weekly and monthly audits completed, with reclamation entries complete and accurate enough to stand as the savings record. TOOLS SYSTEMS CLH Licence Servers: global floating-licence servers, FlexNet and other supported daemons, flat text licence configuration files, and the Altair Floating License Monitor. Entitlement Usage: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking, plus usage scans and SaaS consumption snapshots for licence-position work. Contract Legal: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review pipelines, NDA requests and signature validation. Queue Automation: GUTS and Buganizer for ticket and bug management with strict category coding, and gHive / UiPath for automated reclamation. Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three-way matching. REQUIRED SKILLS EXPERIENCE Mandatory 6-10+ years in software asset management or software licensing operations, including experience as a shift lead, team lead or senior technical escalation point. Hands-on Corporate License Hosting or floating-licence server experience: FlexNet or comparable daemons, editing licence configuration files, troubleshooting daemon and service drops, and reading concurrent-usage metrics. Strong command of EULA and clickwrap review, licence terms and the commercial and legal risk they carry, with the judgment to stop a request rather than pass it through. Proven licence-position work - reconciling entitlement against deployed and consumed usage and defending the result. Comfortable working a rotating or fixed non-standard shift, including the NAMER window (22:00-06:00 IST). Clear English communication and the confidence to hold a technical or compliance line with client stakeholders and publishers. Preferred Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential). Linux and Windows server administration exposure sufficient to work licence-server issues with infrastructure teams. Scripting or automation literacy (Apps Script, Python, UiPath) for reclamation and reporting work. MA software integration exposure, including termination workflows under privacy constraints. Experience supporting publisher business reviews and audit responses

What the Level III owns instead is technical authority: Corporate License Hosting server operations and daemon recovery, Initial and Final Licence Position construction, EULA and clickwrap gating on high-risk requests, publisher and reseller escalation, and the design of the automation that takes repeat work off the queue. The analyst is the technical escalation point the shift lead calls on, and the standard-setter whose method the Level II and Level I analysts are trained against.   CORE COMPETENCIES EXPERTISE Corporate License Hosting - hands-on operation of floating and concurrent licence servers: FlexNet and comparable daemons, licence file structure and safe editing, daemon and service recovery, and concurrent checkout and peak-usage analysis through the Altair Floating License Monitor. Licensing models - working command of perpetual, subscription, SaaS, concurrent/floating and consumable-credit models, and of what each one does to compliance exposure, true-up mechanics and renewal leverage. Licence position audit evidence - building Initial and Final Licence Positions by reconciling entitlement against deployment and consumption evidence, and defending the result to a publisher or an internal auditor. Commercial legal gating - reading EULAs and clickwrap terms for the risk they carry, recognising the use cases that must be stopped rather than processed, and holding the signature-authority boundary without exception. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Corporate License Hosting - Server Daemon Operations Monitor the health of the global licence servers hosting concurrent and floating licences on the shift, working daemon drops and service failures to resolution inside the 4-hour critical SLA. Raise and validate Licence File Change requests on contract renewal, quantity change or expiry, editing the flat text configuration files on the hosting servers correctly and reversibly. Read concurrent checkout and peak-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor - logging in strictly as a guest, and never entering corporate credentials without explicit system-administrator approval. Assess new hosting requests against the CLH eligibility criteria - native floating or concurrent licence support, Windows or Linux server compatibility, a supported daemon (FlexNet preferred), no geolocation or policy usage restrictions, and an active catalogue item carrying user instructions. Apply the CLH request-routing matrix on unlisted floating-licence requests: check the hosted-titles list, broker spare capacity with the product champion on shared pools, bypass pool sharing on private pools, and capture destination MAC addresses where a requester declines hosting. Manage decommissioning: raise the support request to retire the daemon and remove licence files from the server when a hosted product is withdrawn. 2. Licence Position, Renewals Consumption Analysis Act as the technical owner of licence position on the shift - compiling the Initial Licence Position at the 180-day milestone and the Final Licence Position at 60 days, from usage scans, deployment data and SaaS consumption snapshots. Ensure harvested and reclaimed licences are pruned from the baseline before the Final Licence Position is set, so no shelfware is carried into a renewal. Resolve the entitlement and edition questions Level II cannot close - overlapping entitlements, downgrade and second-use rights, bundling and suite coverage, and consumable-credit burn-down. Model true-up exposure against contracted baselines and identify which commercial route applies - an amendment where a signature alters contracted quantities, a purchase-order addition where no signature is required. Validate the accuracy of Deal Radar contract and event records for the renewals in flight on the shift, correcting event typing, recurrence numbering and metadata errors at source rather than downstream. Quantify and evidence savings and cost avoidance in the licence-reclaim audit table, to a standard that survives finance review. 3. High-Risk Gating - EULA, Clickwrap, Legal Authority Controls Own high-risk EULA and clickwrap review on the shift: copy non-signed agreements to secure storage and check the master reviews register to confirm whether an approved review already exists within the last three years before triggering a new one. Enforce the signed-agreement prohibition - signed agreements are never accepted through the standard unlisted queue and must be routed via the contract intake path to be managed as formal legal cases. Identify and reject out-of-scope use cases on sight - code to be incorporated into customer-facing products, personal-device use, and reverse engineering - using the standard responses and correct onward routing. Coordinate vendor security assessments and legal-review pipelines, and track cases needing director-level signature through to execution by the clients own signatory. No member of the team signs or e-signs anything. Hold the sensitive-data controls: licence keys, audit notifications and accessibility information move to the private queue on identification, without exception. 4. Publisher Escalation, Audit Defence, Automation Technical Standards Own the technical escalation path into publishers and resellers for entitlement, key and activation failures the shift cannot resolve, and drive them to closure rather than handing them on. Assemble entitlement, deployment and proof-of-purchase evidence for publisher audits and Semi-Annual Business Reviews, and reconcile discrepancies before they escalate into findings. Identify automation candidates and author Business Requirements Documents where a publisher crosses 1,000 transactions a year, moving work onto robotic process automation or vendor APIs. Configure and audit automated reclamation campaigns in gHive / UiPath, and investigate the failures and false positives the automation produces. Set and maintain the technical standard on the shift: author and refresh SOPs for CLH and licence-position procedures, and coach Level II and Level I analysts on method and casework quality - technical guidance only, with no line authority. PERFORMANCE SERVICE LEVELS Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift. CLH Critical Response: resolve or contain critical Corporate License Hosting issues - daemon drops, server unavailability, checkout failures - within the 4-hour SLA. Technical Escalation Closure: close escalations routed to the expert seat within the shift window, or hand them over with a documented diagnosis and next action. Licence Position Accuracy: Initial and Final Licence Positions delivered on the milestone dates and fully reconcilable to usage evidence. Legal Authority Compliance: zero signed agreements processed through the unlisted queue; zero agreements signed by the team; 100% register check before a new legal review is raised. Savings Integrity: reclamation and cost-avoidance entries complete, evidenced and accurate enough to stand as the savings record. Automation Contribution: at least one automation or SOP improvement delivered per quarter against the shifts highest-volume repeat work. TOOLS SYSTEMS CLH Licence Servers: global floating-licence servers, FlexNet and other supported daemons, flat text licence configuration files, and the Altair Floating License Monitor. Entitlement Usage: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking, plus usage scans and SaaS consumption snapshots for licence-position work. Contract Legal: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review pipelines, NDA requests and signature validation. Queue Automation: Ticketing and issue tracking systems for ticket and bug management with strict category coding, and gHive / UiPath for automated reclamation. Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three-way matching. REQUIRED SKILLS EXPERIENCE Mandatory 6-10+ years in software asset management or software licensing operations, with a track record as a senior technical escalation point rather than a queue processor. Hands-on Corporate License Hosting or floating-licence server experience: FlexNet or comparable daemons, editing licence configuration files, troubleshooting daemon and service drops, and reading concurrent-usage metrics. Comfortable working a fixed or rotating non-standard shift, including the NAMER window (22:00-06:00 IST). Clear English communication and the confidence to hold a technical or compliance line with client stakeholders, publishers and resellers. Preferred Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential). Linux and Windows server administration exposure sufficient to work licence-server issues alongside infrastructure teams. Scripting or automation literacy (Python, Apps Script, UiPath) for reclamation, reporting and BRD authoring. Experience supporting publisher business reviews, audit responses or negotiation preparation.

title: Marketing Apprentice
description:
Marketing Apprentice Sony MAX 
 If you've ever watched a movie trailer and thought, I could market this better this might be your sign. What makes people stop scrolling?
What makes a movie become a conversation?
What turns a campaign into something people actually remember? 
 If you find yourself thinking about questions like these, Sony MAX wants you. 
 Were looking for a Marketing Apprentice to join the Sony MAX Marketing team in Mumbai and get a front-row seat to the world of entertainment, movies, campaigns, digital and social media. 
 This is a paid, 12-month apprenticeship opportunity under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) , offering hands-on exposure to marketing within one of India's leading media and entertainment networks. And no, this isn't a role where you'll just be making spreadsheets and sitting in meetings. 
 You’ll be working with the team that helps put movies, campaigns and entertainment moments in front of millions of viewers. About Sony Pictures Networks India Sony Pictures Networks India (SPNI) is one of India's leading media and entertainment companies and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan. 
 With a portfolio spanning entertainment, movies, sports, kids, factual entertainment and digital, SPNI reaches 700+ million viewers across India and operates brands including Sony MAX, Sony Entertainment Television, Sony SAB, Sony Sports Network and Sony LIV. 
 At the heart of our movie entertainment portfolio is Sony MAX — a brand built around Hindi cinema, iconic movies and the moments audiences love talking about. At SPNI, we believe in being Brave. Visionary. Curious. Insightful. We’re looking for someone who brings exactly that energy. What You’ll Be Doing 
 Bring Campaigns to Life Support the planning and execution of Sony MAX marketing campaigns Coordinate with internal teams, agencies and external partners Help manage campaign timelines, deliverables and creative assets Support promotional activities and campaign initiatives Keep track of what's happening, what's pending and what needs to happen next Live on the Internet? Good. Track social media trends, memes, conversations and entertainment culture Support digital and social media campaigns Brainstorm content ideas around movies, actors, pop culture and trends Assist with captions, content formats and campaign extensions Monitor campaign performance and help maintain reports and trackers Be Curious Research Bollywood, audience behaviour, competitors and entertainment trends Keep an eye on what's working across digital platforms Identify interesting conversations and opportunities for the brand Bring new ideas to the table, even if they're a little unconventional Make Things Happen Work with multiple stakeholders across marketing and other functions Support presentations, reports, trackers and campaign documentation Follow up on deliverables and timelines Take ownership of assigned projects and see them through 
 Who Are We Looking For? We aren't looking for someone who has memorised a marketing textbook. We’re looking for someone who gets people. Someone who: Loves movies, entertainment, pop culture and digital media Is naturally curious about why people watch, click, share and engage Spots trends before they become yesterday's news Has ideas and isn't afraid to say them out loud Has strong communication and coordination skills Can juggle multiple things without losing track of the details Is comfortable with PowerPoint, Excel and everyday digital tools Has internship, project or college experience in marketing, social media, content, media, events or related areas 
 Freshers are welcome to apply. NAPS Apprenticeship Eligibility This opportunity is offered under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) . Before applying, please ensure that you meet the apprenticeship eligibility requirements, including: This is a 12-month paid apprenticeship The candidate must be eligible to register under the NAPS apprenticeship program Candidates should not have an existing UAN/PF account number Candidates must be able to complete the required apprenticeship registration and documentation Additional eligibility requirements under the NAPS program will apply Please note: Candidates with an existing UAN/PF account may not be eligible for this apprenticeship opportunity. You Might Be Our Person If... 
 If movies, marketing, social media and big ideas sounds like your kind of combination, we want to hear from you. Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Bring your pop-culture knowledge. We'll bring the movies. Apply now to join the Sony MAX Marketing team.

title: Sr. Manager, HR technology (Workday)
description:
Senior Manager, HR Technology Location: Pune, India | Reports to: Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering Job Summary The Senior Manager, HR Technology owns the strategy, roadmap, administration, and continuous improvement of OpenGovs HR technology stack, ensuring the systems and integrations that manage employee data across the employee lifecycle are reliable, compliant, scalable, and aligned to the needs of a global workforce. Based in Pune, India and reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering, this role sets direction for HR technology across the organization and leads a team that includes HR application administrators and a staff-level HR Systems Architect. It partners with stakeholders across the US and India — HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, IT, and Workplace — to maintain, modernize, and streamline the systems that support the full employee lifecycle, from hire to retire and onboarding to offboarding. The ideal candidate is a seasoned HR technology leader who pairs strategic ownership with deep, hands-on expertise — comfortable setting the HR technology roadmap and standards while staying close enough to the Workday stack and broader application portfolio to guide technical decisions, unblock the team, and ensure quality. This person leads and develops the team, including a staff-level architect and senior individual contributors, and brings domain depth spanning both US and India geographies, ideally complemented by experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP. The Senior Manager owns the technical relationship with Ashby (ATS), oversees the employee engagement survey platform, owns HR data governance in partnership with IT, and guides integration/systems architecture across the HR ecosystem — including how HRIS data flows into NetSuite/ERP and downstream platforms. Responsibilities Leadership, Strategy & People Management Own the HR technology strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligning system investments and priorities with HR and business objectives and communicating direction to stakeholders and leadership. Lead, mentor, and grow a team spanning HR application administrators and a staff-level HR Systems Architect — setting priorities, developing technical and functional skills, managing senior individual contributors, and building depth and backup coverage across critical domains. Provide technical and architectural direction: guide the staff architect and the team on integration architecture, data structures, and design decisions while staying hands-on enough across the Workday stack and broader portfolio to ensure quality and remove blockers. Manage team intake, capacity, and prioritization across a broad portfolio of projects and day-to-day support, adhering to deadlines and communicating status to stakeholders and leadership. Own vendor and implementation-partner relationships and contribute to HR technology budget and tooling decisions. HR Systems Administration & Domain Support Direct and provide administration, configuration, support, and maintenance across OpenGov’s HR and Payroll systems, including the full Workday suite (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting, and Security). Provide hands-on techno-functional expertise across payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, and general HR operations — for both US and India geographies. Support India- and US-specific processes and regulatory requirements, including localized absence, compensation, and payroll configurations. Own the technical relationship with Ashby (ATS) — integration health, configuration, and offer workflows — and set strategic direction for the talent acquisition technology stack. Oversee the employee engagement survey platform (e.g., CultureAmp), including survey launches, configuration, and data management. Ensure regular audits are performed to maintain proper functioning of system processes and data integrity across HR applications. Projects & Stakeholder Partnership Partner with client groups and stakeholders globally to evaluate business needs, shape solutions, and recommend system-based approaches.  Who We Are

 At SEW, the vision is to Engage, Empower, and Educate billions of people to save energy and water. We partner with businesses to deliver platforms that are easy-to-use, integrate seamlessly, and help build a strong technology foundation that allows them to become future- ready.

Our platforms empower billions of global users. We have been awarded 150+ accolades to date. Our clients are continually awarded by industry analysts for implementing our award-winning product. Partnering with hiring managers to determine staffing needs. Performing reference and background checks making sure of an effective verification process.

description:
Job Description Technical Support Engineer Magento Company: Adobe Location: Noida 

 Role: Technical Support Engineer Magento Role Overview Join Adobe Commerce Cloud as a Technical Support Engineer Magento and help customers solve complex technical issues across their Magento/Adobe Commerce environments. This role involves troubleshooting Magento applications, Linux environments, databases, web servers, performance issues, and integrations while working closely with customers and internal technical teams. 
 Magento Developers with strong technical troubleshooting skills are welcome to apply. Prior technical support experience is not mandatory if you have strong hands-on Magento and related technology experience. 
 Key Responsibilities Act as a technical point of contact for Magento/Adobe Commerce issues. Troubleshoot Magento applications, Linux environments, web servers, and databases . Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes. Troubleshoot issues related to performance, checkout, cart, sessions, integrations, and search . Work with technologies such as MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, NGINX/Apache, DNS, CDN, and SSL . Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve complex production issues. Provide timely resolutions in accordance with SLA requirements . Create and maintain technical documentation and troubleshooting guides. Participate in on-call/weekend support rotations as required. Communicate technical issues and resolutions clearly to customers. 
 Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience with Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce . Strong knowledge of PHP . Experience with MySQL / SQL and database troubleshooting. Good understanding of Linux/Ubuntu environments. Exposure to NGINX or Apache . Experience with Redis and/or Elasticsearch . Understanding of web application troubleshooting and performance optimization. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Good understanding of application architecture and production environments. 
 Good to Have Experience with DNS, CDN and SSL . Experience with REST APIs / GraphQL . Scripting knowledge in Python, Java, Node.js or Perl . Experience working with e-commerce platforms . Experience handling customer-facing technical issues or production support. 
 Important Note for Candidates This is a Technical Support Engineer role, but candidates do not need to come from a Technical Support designation. Magento Developers with strong technical skills, debugging experience and knowledge of the above technology stack are encouraged to apply. Experience 2+ years of relevant Magento/Adobe Commerce experience preferred. Location Noida

Production Support and Operations • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for production automations and platform issues. • Perform root-cause analysis for failed jobs, infrastructure incidents, queue failures, application changes, and robot availability issues. • Manage incident, problem, change, and release activities in accordance with organizational processes. • Monitor scheduled automations and proactively prevent operational failures. • Improve automation stability, performance, maintainability, and infrastructure utilization. • Coordinate production deployments and provide post-deployment support. • Maintain operational dashboards, audit records, incident documentation, and service-level metrics. • Participate in planned maintenance and critical production-support activities when required.

 Preferred Skills • Experience with UiPath Automation Cloud, Automation Suite, or on-premises Orchestrator. • Exposure to high-availability and disaster-recovery configurations. • Experience with SQL Server configuration and UiPath database connectivity. • Knowledge of load balancers, DNS, SSL certificates, reverse proxies, and firewall configuration. • Exposure to Microsoft Azure or AWS. • Experience with UiPath Insights, Action Center, Document Understanding, AI Center, Integration Service, or Test Suite. • Knowledge of PowerShell, VB.NET, C#, Python, or related scripting. • Experience integrating UiPath with ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft 365, or other enterprise applications. • Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and release-management processes. • UiPath Certified Professional certification is desirable.

 Education • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. • Relevant UiPath certifications will be considered an advantage.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications 
 What You Bring to the Team BS in Computer Science or a related field, or demonstrable equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software development experience using technologies such as C#, WPF, Java, Python, and/or JavaScript. 4+ years of leadership experience with a focus on mentorship, career growth, and delivery. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications 
 What You Bring to the Team BS in Computer Science or a related field, or demonstrable equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software development experience using technologies such as C#, WPF, Java, Python, and/or JavaScript. 4+ years of leadership experience with a focus on mentorship, career growth, and delivery. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

Extensive experience with Selenium and Playwright automation tools. Strong experience in API testing and automation using RestAssured or equivalent tools. Expertise in integration testing, functional testing, regression testing, and end-to-end testing. Experience designing scalable automation frameworks from scratch. Working knowledge of Neo4j graph databases and Cypher Query Language. Understanding of graph database concepts and validation techniques. Experience testing vector databases such as Milvus, Qdrant, or similar platforms. Strong hands-on experience with performance and load testing using JMeter and k6. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based testing environments. Experience validating cloud-native and distributed application architectures. Strong knowledge of GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD automation practices. Understanding of Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working with enterprise-scale applications and complex distributed systems. Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and within cross-functional Agile teams. Strong focus on software quality, automation excellence, and continuous improvement.
