 About the Role We are looking for a Customer Support Executive who enjoys interacting with customers, solving problems and helping people find the right solutions. This role will handle the complete customer journey - from pre-sales enquiries and order assistance to post-sales support and follow-ups . The role involves both inbound and outbound calls, customer conversations, sales support and coordination with internal teams . Since MrMed deals with specialty medicines, the role also requires the ability to understand and learn about prescription requirements, specialty medicines and healthcare-related processes . Key Responsibilities Customer Support Handle inbound and outbound calls from customers. Respond to customer queries related to medicines, orders, pricing, availability and delivery. Understand customer concerns and provide timely and appropriate solutions. Handle delayed deliveries, order issues, refunds, cancellations and other post-sales queries with empathy. Follow up with customers and ensure issues are closed properly. Maintain a positive and helpful customer experience throughout the interaction. Sales Pre-Sales Support Understand customer requirements and assist them in placing orders. Handle pre-sales enquiries and support customers in making informed purchase decisions. Follow up with potential customers and pending orders. Support sales conversion through effective customer conversations and follow-ups. Communicate product availability, offers and relevant benefits appropriately. Work towards defined sales and revenue targets. Prescription Specialty Medicine Support Understand and follow the companys processes for prescription-based medicines. Politely explain prescription requirements to customers when applicable. Guide customers on uploading or sharing valid prescriptions. Develop basic knowledge of specialty medicines, medical terminology and healthcare processes. Coordinate with pharmacists and internal teams whenever customer queries require further assistance. Order Issue Resolution Coordinate with Pharmacy, Procurement, Operations, Logistics and Sales teams to resolve customer issues. Track out-of-stock medicines and follow up on availability. Explore possible options as per company guidelines when a required medicine is unavailable. Keep customers informed about order status, availability and expected timelines. Handle customer concerns professionally, even in difficult situations. Customer Experience Listen patiently and understand the customers actual concern. Communicate clearly and empathetically, especially when dealing with patients or their family members. Take ownership of customer issues and ensure proper follow-up. Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, orders and follow-ups. Ensure every interaction leaves the customer feeling heard, supported and cared for. What We re Looking For 1+ year of experience in Customer Support, Inside Sales, Telecalling, Telesales, Customer Experience, Healthcare or E-commerce. Any Graduate. Good verbal communication skills. Comfortable handling both inbound and outbound calls. Customer-friendly, patient and empathetic approach. Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics. Good follow-up and problem-solving skills. Ability to handle multiple conversations/tasks in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to work in rotational shifts, if required. Comfortable learning about medicines, medical terms and healthcare processes. Basic computer skills and familiarity with CRM/order management systems. 
 Why Join MrMed At MrMed, the customer is often someone looking for an important medicine for themselves or their family. Every conversation matters. We are looking for people who bring empathy, ownership, energy and a genuine willingness to help - while also enjoying the excitement of sales and customer interaction. If you enjoy talking to people, solving problems and turning a customer conversation into a positive experience, we would love to meet you.

title: Support - Key Account Management
description:
Job Title : Support - Key Account Manager 
 JOB PURPOSE To support the Key Account Management (KAM) function by executing day-to-day account operations, coordinating cross-functional actions for RFQs and ongoing programs, maintaining accurate commercial and delivery data, and ensuring timely, high-quality responses to customer needs thereby enabling the KAMs and the BD organization to achieve revenue, margin, and customer satisfaction goals. 
 PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES 
 1) Account Operations & Customer Support Execute day-to-day account tasks (RFQ trackers, samples dispatch follow-ups, documentation, MOMs) to ensure timely responses to customers and internal teams. Act as the first line of support for routine customer queries and coordinate resolutions with KAM. 2) RFQ & Proposal Coordination Collect customer requirements/specs, liaise with Costing, Engineering, SCM, and Quality, and compile inputs for techno-commercial proposals under KAMs guidance. Maintain RFQ status dashboards, ensure milestones are met, and prepare submission packs. 3) Order Management & Delivery Assurance Track POs/LOIs, schedules, dispatch plans, and deliveries; highlight risks (shortages, logistics holds) and drive cross-functional actions to closure. Monitor ASN/GRN status and support OTIF performance improvements. 4) Commercial & Data Management Maintain price files, change notes, debits/credits, claims, and customer portals with 100% accuracy. Support price revision workings, basic contribution analysis, and VAVE savings tracking. 5) Issue Tracking & Escalation Management Log and monitor open issues (quality complaints, line-stop risks, payment delays), coordinate 8D/Corrective Actions with Quality/Plant, and report weekly status to KAM. Escalate critical risks with clear facts, impact, and proposed mitigations. 6) Reporting, Analytics & MIS Prepare weekly/monthly account dashboards, win/loss snapshots, RFQ funnels, delivery/PPM/OTIF metrics, and customer scorecard previews. Maintain accurate master data and audit-ready documentation on shared drives/PLM/ERP as applicable. Update RFQ/quote trackers; request and consolidate inputs from Costing/R&D/SCM. Download/customer-portal tasks: schedules, drawings, change notices, vendor ratings. Create and circulate MOMs for customer and internal review meetings. Follow up on samples/PPAP submissions, tooling milestones, and pilot builds. Update price lists, PO acknowledgements, and invoice/collection status. Prepare weekly dashboards for KAM and participate in internal stand-ups. Track competition news, program timelines, and model changeovers relevant to the account. Managing frequent, time-bound requests from customers while coordinating multiple internal functions. Maintaining data accuracy across systems/portals amid frequent engineering/commercial changes. Ensuring delivery hygiene (OTIF) in volatile demand situations and supply constraints. Handling simultaneous RFQs and program activities without slippage. Any commercial commitment, price deviation, or T&C changes. Priority conflicts across programs that affect deliveries or customer milestones. Quality issues, penalties, or claims with financial impact. RFQ submissions that deviate from approved assumptions/costs.

Key Skills: Key account management,Day to Day Operations,RFQ,Quotation,Account management,Management,Key,Key accounts

The role will be responsible for end-to-end procurement activities including IT product sourcing, RFQs, supplier evaluation, commercial negotiation, purchase order processing, P2P operations, vendor management, order follow-up, delivery coordination and cost optimization. This position requires a procurement professional who understands the IT technology ecosystem and can independently manage procurement activities from requirement and sourcing through order fulfilment. Key Responsibilities IT Hardware & Software Procurement Source and procure IT hardware, software, licenses, subscriptions and other technology products based on business and project requirements. Work with IT OEMs, distributors, resellers, system integrators and technology suppliers to obtain competitive pricing and availability. Build and maintain effective relationships with OEMs, distributors, resellers and technology suppliers. Monitor supplier performance, commitments and service levels. Resolve supplier-related commercial, delivery and order issues proactively. P2P & Purchase Order Processing Manage the complete Procure-to-Pay cycle from requirement/PR through RFQ, quotation evaluation, approvals and PO creation. Process purchase orders accurately through ERP systems, including product details, quantities, pricing, delivery terms and payment terms. Coordinate with suppliers for PO acknowledgement, order confirmation and fulfilment. Maintain accurate procurement records, quotations, supplier documents and purchase orders. Order & Delivery Management Track supplier order status, committed ETAs, shipments and delivery schedules. Follow up proactively with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of hardware, software and licenses. Identify and escalate delivery risks, shortages, order discrepancies and delays. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure materials and licenses are delivered as required. Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with Sales, Finance, Logistics, Operations, Warehouse and Business teams. Understand business and project requirements and translate them into procurement actions. Provide regular updates on procurement status, pending orders, supplier commitments and delivery risks. Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, approval requirements and commercial guidelines. Mandatory Requirements 4-6 years of relevant experience in Procurement / Purchasing / Sourcing within the IT / Technology industry. Hands-on experience in procurement of IT Hardware and Software is mandatory. Experience working with IT OEMs, distributors, resellers, system integrators, channel partners or technology suppliers. Strong understanding of IT procurement, sourcing, RFQ and commercial processes. Hands-on experience with the complete P2P process and ERP-based purchase order processing. Strong supplier negotiation, vendor management and follow-up skills. Demonstrated experience in cost optimization and obtaining competitive commercial terms. Good understanding of IT product part numbers, configurations, software licenses, subscriptions and renewals. Strong communication, analytical and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Relevant Industry Background Candidates with procurement experience in the following environments will be considered: IT Hardware & Software Resellers IT Distributors IT System Integrators Technology Trading Companies IT Solution Providers Managed Services / Technology Service Providers OEM / Distributor procurement environments Important Screening Criteria IT / Technology procurement experience is mandatory for this position. Candidates whose experience is limited to general procurement without hands-on exposure to IT Hardware and Software procurement will not be considered. Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical experience in sourcing, RFQ handling, supplier negotiation, P2P/PO processing and delivery follow-up within an IT procurement environment. Preferred Experience Experience managing multiple IT distributors and channel partners. Experience handling project-based or urgent IT procurement requirements. Exposure to software licensing, subscriptions and renewals. Experience negotiating price, credit terms, delivery timelines and supplier commitments. Experience in IT technology trading or distribution environments. What Were Looking For We are looking for a proactive, commercially aware and detail-oriented IT procurement professional who can independently manage the procurement cycle: Requirement Sourcing / RFQ Supplier Evaluation Negotiation PO Supplier Confirmation ETA Follow-up Delivery Closure The successful candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced technology procurement environment and coordinating with suppliers and multiple internal stakeholders.

Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. title: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre
description:
About DP World Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the worlds trade flow better, changing whats possible for the customers and communities we serve globally. With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain thats fit for the future. We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades. What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door. 
 About DP World Global Service Centre DP World’s Global Service Centre (GSCs) are key enablers of growth delivering standardization, process excellence and expertise, and automation in areas of Finance, Freight Forwarding, Marine Services, Engineering and Human Resources, helping accelerate DP World’s growth and business transformation. As we experience exponential growth, there has never been a more exciting time to join us. Discover your next role here and change what's possible for everyone! As an equal employer that recognizes and values diversity and an inclusive culture, we empower and up-skill our people with opportunities to perform at their best. Join us and be part of an amazing team that is transforming the future of world trade. 
 Role Purpose Lead the end-to-end design and transition of work from regions into the GSC, shaping sustainable delivery solutions from target operating model, organization and team structure, capacity and skill requirements, governance and controls through knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live and stabilization. Independently partner with regional and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions and ensure controlled, transparent and successful transitions.
 
 Designation: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre Department – Business Process Base Location: Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai Reporting To: Vice President 
 Key Role Responsibilities Collaborate independently with regional stakeholders and GSC functional owners to understand business objectives, process scope, pain points, volumes, service expectations, controls and dependencies. Design end-to-end GSC / offshoring solutions, including target operating model, team structure, spans and layers, capacity, skill mix, governance and charge back. Translate the agreed solution into detailed process scope, resource requirements, implementation approach, dependencies, assumptions, service levels, controls and measurable business outcomes. Apply strong knowledge of GSC, shared services and offshoring models, transition methodologies, process design, operational controls and industry best practices to develop practical and scalable solutions. Act as a trusted advisor and primary transition / solutioning partner to senior regional and functional stakeholders, independently leading discussions, workshops, negotiations and decision-making forums. Communicate solution options, trade-offs, risks, dependencies and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders; constructively challenge assumptions where required to protect transition and operational outcomes. Collaborate with GSC leadership, operations, process owners, HR, finance, technology, Process Excellence and other enabling functions to validate solution feasibility and ensure end-to-end implementation readiness. Define clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights and governance across regional and GSC teams throughout solution design, transition and stabilization. Prepare and maintain comprehensive solution and transition documentation, including scope and process maps, target operating model, organization design, resource and capacity plans, RACI, assumptions, dependencies, business case inputs, implementation plans and governance packs. Own end-to-end transitions of process scope from regions into the GSC, from initiation and due diligence through planning, knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live, stabilization and formal handover to operations. Define transition objectives, in-scope / out-of-scope activities, success measures, milestones, deliverables and acceptance criteria jointly with stakeholders and receiving operations teams. Develop and manage integrated transition plans covering resourcing, hiring and onboarding, knowledge transfer, training, access and technology readiness, controls, documentation, communications and operational readiness. Establish and govern structured transition toll gates with clear entry / exit criteria and evidence-based readiness assessments; ensure appropriate stakeholder sign-offs before progression and go-live. Maintain robust RAID management, proactively identifying risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies; define mitigants, owners and escalation paths and drive timely resolution of roadblocks. Lead transition governance and stakeholder reporting, tracking milestones, actions, decisions, readiness and overall transition health; escalate material risks or deviations with clear recommendations and recovery plans. Manage go-live and stabilization / hypercare, monitor agreed service and quality indicators, close residual risks and actions, capture lessons learned and complete a structured handover to business-as-usual operations. 
 Skills & Competencies Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with significant hands-on experience in transition management, solutioning, shared services / GSC, BPO or offshoring environments. Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional transitions is essential. Strong knowledge of transition and solutioning frameworks, target operating model and organization design, capacity / resource planning, governance, toll-gate methodology, risk management, process migration and operational readiness. Strong analytical, structured problem-solving and commercial mindset, with the ability to convert ambiguous requirements into executable solutions and transition plans. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills, with confidence engaging independently with senior leaders across regions and functions. Strong project and program management capability, including governance, milestone management, RAID management, executive reporting and management of multiple concurrent transitions. Demonstrated ownership, judgement and decision-making ability; comfortable challenging constructively, managing competing priorities and driving outcomes in a matrixed, multicultural environment. Strong change leadership and knowledge-transfer capability, with a focus on business continuity, control effectiveness, service quality and sustainable adoption. Ability to work autonomously, travel as required for transition activity, and manage stakeholders across geographies and time zones. 
 Education & Qualifications Minimum bachelor's degree in Business Management, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree and/or recognized project, transition or change management certification (e.g., PMP) is a plus. . DP World is committed to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success and we make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief.

The role requires ensuring accuracy of financial records, timely statutory filings and compliance with applicable regulations and deadlines. 1. Audit & Compliance Support Assist in the preparation of GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C for annual GST compliance/audit. Support Tax Audit, Statutory Audit, Cost Audit and ASI Audit activities. Prepare schedules, reports and audit working papers. Coordinate with auditors and provide required financial information and supporting documents. Address and resolve audit queries with accurate supporting data. 5. Transfer Pricing & Regulatory Support Assist in transfer pricing-related workings. Accuracy and completeness of statutory registers and supporting documentation. Required Competencies Strong understanding of GST, TDS and TCS compliance. title: Indirect sourcing- Procurement Executive
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Senior Executive Indirect Procurement will manage end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities for the organisation's India operations across three offices – Bangalore, Calicut and Gurgaon – covering indirect categories including IT, HR, Facilities, Finance, Professional services and Office Fit-outs. In addition, the role will be responsible for Purchase Requisition (PR) to Purchase Order (PO) conversion for the Retail vertical managed out of the GCC. The incumbent will be responsible for cost optimisation, supplier performance, procurement governance, contract administration and stakeholder satisfaction, while ensuring compliance with defined procurement policies, Delegation of Authority and approval processes. The role covers RFx management, negotiations, vendor onboarding, contract coordination, spend analysis, category reporting, PR-to-PO execution and supplier relationship management. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Category Management (India – Bangalore, Calicut, Gurgaon) 
 Manage sourcing activities across indirect categories including IT (hardware, software, licenses, AMCs, telecom, connectivity), HR (recruitment, training, background verification, employee engagement, benefits), Facilities (housekeeping, security, cafeteria, pantry, transport, utilities, R&M), Finance (audit, tax advisory, professional services) and Office Fit-outs (interiors, civil, MEP, furniture, workstations, relocation). Execute RFQs, RFPs and commercial bid evaluations in line with procurement policy and approval requirements across the three India offices. Conduct market intelligence, benchmarking and supplier discovery to support competitive sourcing decisions. Identify and deliver cost-saving, consolidation and value-engineering opportunities across the India office footprint. Drive category planning, demand aggregation and rate-contract coverage across Bangalore, Calicut and Gurgaon. 
 2. PR to PO Execution (Retail Vertical – GCC) Create and process Purchase Orders (POs) for the Retail vertical handled out of the GCC, in accordance with organisational policies and approval workflows. Track PR-to-PO turnaround time and maintain procurement timelines within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Process purchase requisitions and purchase orders for recurring requirements based on rate cards and active contracts. Issue Purchase Orders to approved suppliers and ensure timely order confirmation and delivery. Respond to internal teams and suppliers on order status, changes, amendments or cancellations. Prepare and maintain a real-time procurement tracker; monitor pending PRs and POs and drive closure. 
 3. Stakeholder Management Partner with IT, HR, Admin, Facilities, Finance, Retail business teams and other stakeholders across India and GCC to understand requirements and priorities. Translate business needs into clear sourcing plans, commercial specifications and supplier engagement strategies. Support timely procurement closure for projects, office fit-outs, retail rollouts and operational requirements. 4. Vendor Management Identify, evaluate, onboard and maintain vendor relationships for indirect categories across the three India locations. Monitor supplier performance, service levels, commercial commitments and issue resolution. Support supplier risk assessments, vendor rationalisation and business continuity initiatives. Coordinate resolution of supplier disputes, delivery concerns and commercial escalations. 
 5. Commercial Negotiation Lead or support commercial negotiations to achieve optimum pricing, service levels, payment terms and contractual safeguards. Prepare negotiation notes, comparative statements and commercial evaluation summaries for approval. Track negotiated savings, avoided costs and value additions in a transparent and auditable manner. 
 6. Contract & Governance Support contract drafting, renewal, amendment and closure in coordination with Legal and business stakeholders. Ensure documentation, approvals and sourcing records are maintained as per procurement governance requirements. Maintain audit-ready files including quotations, comparative statements, approvals, award recommendations, POs, GRNs and supplier communications. Ensure adherence to Delegation of Authority, procurement policy, conflict-of-interest requirements and compliance standards. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Technical Skills 
 Behavioural Competencies Strategic sourcing & category management PR-to-PO processing and PO creation RFx / tender management Vendor evaluation & management Cost benchmarking & spend analysis Contract management Procurement analytics & reporting MS Excel (advanced); Power BI preferred ERP exposure – Oracle preferred; MS D365 an advantage 
 Strong negotiation skills Commercial acumen Stakeholder management across geographies Analytical thinking & problem solving Attention to detail Communication and presentation skills Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously Ownership mindset and compliance orientation Ability to work under minimum supervision in a fast-paced environment 
 Additional Requirements Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate Diploma / Professional Degree in any relevant field; MBA / PGDM / CIPS preferred. 5 – 6 years of relevant experience in indirect procurement, with hands-on exposure to both strategic sourcing and PR-to-PO transactional execution. Ability to work with diverse teams across multiple geographies (India and GCC). Computer literate with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Preferred hands-on experience on Oracle Fusion and / or MS Dynamics 365. Resourceful with a positive attitude, able to work independently a

description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications

Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. title: Mechanical Design Engineer-Transformer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Design Engineer Mechanical for our Transformer Division, responsible for the mechanical design and development of Power Transformers, Dry-Type Transformers, and Locomotive Transformers and their associated components. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in transformer tank design, locomotive transformer tank design, transformer component design, 2D/3D modelling, fabrication drawings, and engineering documentation . The role requires close coordination with electrical design, manufacturing, production, fabrication, quality, and testing teams to ensure that designs are technically sound, manufacturable, and meet project requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for Power Transformers, Dry-Type Transformers, and Locomotive Transformers . Develop transformer tank designs , including locomotive transformer tank design , considering structural strength, dimensions, clearances, mounting arrangements, fabrication requirements, and service conditions. Prepare detailed 2D manufacturing/fabrication drawings and 3D models of transformer tanks, structures, enclosures, supports, brackets, covers, and other transformer components. Design transformer-related mechanical components as per technical specifications, customer requirements, applicable standards, and manufacturing practices . Perform basic mechanical design calculations related to strength, loading, dimensions, support arrangements, and structural requirements wherever required. Develop and modify designs based on engineering changes, manufacturing requirements, customer specifications, and design review feedback . Prepare assembly drawings, detailed part drawings, BOMs, and revision-controlled engineering documents . Ensure proper fitment, dimensional accuracy, tolerances, clearances, and manufacturability of designed components. Coordinate with production, fabrication, procurement, quality, electrical design, and testing teams for smooth execution of transformer projects. Review shop-floor issues related to drawings and provide appropriate design modifications or technical solutions. Support prototype development, first-piece inspection, design validation, and resolution of design-related manufacturing issues. Maintain proper drawing standards, design records, revisions, and engineering documentation . Participate in design review meetings and support continuous improvement in transformer design, cost, manufacturability, and reliability. 
 Required Technical Skills Strong knowledge of Transformer Mechanical Design and Transformer Components . Hands-on experience in Power Transformer Design . Experience in Dry-Type Transformer Design . Experience in Locomotive Transformer Design will be preferable, particularly locomotive transformer tank design . Good knowledge of Transformer Tank Design and fabrication . Good understanding of transformer mechanical construction, components, assemblies, supports, enclosures, and mounting arrangements. Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D/3D . Hands-on experience with SolidWorks or Solid Edge for 3D modelling and design. Good knowledge of engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensions, tolerances, and fabrication drawings . Ability to interpret technical specifications and convert requirements into practical mechanical designs. Knowledge of material selection, sheet-metal/fabrication practices, welding, machining, and manufacturing processes relevant to transformer components. Ability to troubleshoot drawing/design issues and provide practical engineering solutions.

 On a typical day you might move an interview at one of our Australian campuses and rebook the room before lunch, bring a dozen candidate records in Rippling up to date with a note on each so the Talent Partner can read status at a glance, and chase an overdue video assessment and a hiring manager's feedback before you log off. 
 About Contour 
 We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. This role sits in the Talent Acquisition team within People and Culture, which hires for all three brands. 
 Contour runs dozens of open roles at a time across tutoring, campus and support teams. This is the seat every one of those candidates passes through. 
 About This Role 
 You are the coordinator behind Contour's hiring pipeline: the person who books every interview, keeps every candidate record in Rippling accurate, and follows every assessment and piece of feedback through until it lands. 
 You report to the Talent Partner, who is based in Australia. They own hiring strategy, phone screens and interviews, offers, and the relationship with hiring managers. Everything that moves a candidate from one of those conversations to the next is yours: scheduling, records, assessments, follow-ups, and the talent pools behind upcoming roles. Candidate calls stay onshore. Your work is written, in Rippling, email and SMS, across every candidate at every stage. 
 Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, process discipline: you run the workflow the same way every time, and when a step keeps breaking you flag it before it costs a missed interview. Second, you chase early and you chase again: an unconfirmed interview, an overdue assessment or a hiring manager's feedback never sits in your queue waiting for someone to ask about it. 
 You are the only coordinator on the team and you have no reports. The sourcing and talent-pool work is the part of the seat that grows with you. 
 Hiring at Contour has outgrown the time one Talent Partner can give to coordination. You take that work on, so their time goes to sourcing, hiring managers and offers. By the end of month three, every active candidate's status in Rippling is accurate within a day of any touchpoint, new interviews are booked within two working days of the request, no candidate has gone five business days without hearing from us, and the first talent pools for recurring roles are built and current. The templates, trackers and pools you set up in those months will outlast the roles they were built for. 
 Where the Work Lives 
 Rippling: the ATS. Interviews are booked from here and candidates receive their invites from it, and every candidate record, stage move and note lives here, so a touchpoint you have not logged does not exist as far as the team is concerned. 
 VideoAsk: video assessments go out and come back through here. You send them, watch for what has not come back, and sort out resubmissions when a file is corrupted or the audio is missing. 
 SEEK Talent Search: sourcing and talent pools, against criteria the Talent Partner sets. Templated outreach is yours to send; anything off-template goes past the Talent Partner first. 
 Shared inbox and calendars: candidate queries land in the shared inbox and you decide which ones need escalating; reschedules and cancellations move through the calendar the same day hiring priorities change. 
 What You Will Do 
 Own interview scheduling end to end. Book, confirm and reschedule interviews across phone, video and campus formats, send candidates the time, location and interviewer, line up interviewer availability, raise room bookings for interviews at our Australian campuses, and follow up anyone who has not confirmed, by SMS when email goes quiet. 
 Keep the Rippling pipeline accurate for every open role. Move candidates to the right stage as it happens, log each touchpoint as a note (assessment sent, follow-up made, video resubmitted), file documents to the right candidate, and action hiring managers' requests on the profile itself. 
 Run assessments and get overdue feedback in. Send pre-interview and skills assessments, track completion against due dates, and push overdue hiring-manager feedback before it stalls a pipeline. 
 Handle routine candidate communication. Status updates, extension requests and confirmations of receipt go out on approved templates on behalf of the Talent Partner, at every stage of the process. You flag anything that needs the Talent Partner's judgement. 
 Source and keep talent pools warm. Build longlists and shortlists in SEEK Talent Search against the Talent Partner's brief, send first-contact and follow-up messages on the approved templates, and keep pools for recurring and hard-to-fill roles current. 
 Support reporting and the admin around hiring. Pull open-role, stage-count and time-to-fill data from Rippling, format job ads, candidate summaries and interview packs, and take the notes in recruitment catch-ups and follow up the actions. 
 If a template, tracker or tool would remove a manual step, make the case and we will back it. 
 
 Requirements What You Need 
 1 to 4 years in a recruitment or HR coordination role, agency, RPO or in-house, where you kept a live pipeline of candidates on track 
 Hands-on with an ATS: you can move stages, log notes, upload documents and pull a basic report without help 
 Writing that lands with someone who has never met you. Your confirmations, follow-ups and status updates are a candidate's whole experience of Contour until interview day, so a clear, warm, correct email is the core skill of this role 
 Organised at volume: many candidates across many roles, each at a different stage, none of them dropped 
 Detail that catches problems early: a wrong interview time, a stage that does not match the last note, a misspelt name, all caught before the candidate sees them 
 Same-day turnaround on scheduling requests, follow-ups and record updates. A pipeline that waits on you slows down for everyone 
 Comfortable sourcing on a platform like SEEK Talent Search or LinkedIn against a set brief 
 Comfortable working fully remote across the India and Australia time difference, with an onshore Talent Partner as your daily counterpart 
 Nice to Have 
 Hands-on Rippling experience 
 VideoAsk or another video assessment platform 
 Experience supporting an Australian or other overseas hiring team from India 
 EdTech, education services or a student-facing organisation background 
 The Kind of People Who Thrive Here 
 The people who do well here see a gap and close it without waiting to be told. They keep their work visible: on a remote team, the difference between a coordinator the team trusts and one it has to check on is whether the team can see what is happening, so being visible is part of the job. They give direct feedback and expect it back. They give a candidate bad news with the same care as good news. When a process is not working, they say so and bring a fix with them. 
 Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here. 
 What Good Looks Like 
 Nothing slips: every candidate knows where they stand, and no interview or assessment sits unconfirmed past its date. 
 The pipeline tells the truth: any hiring manager can open Rippling and see exactly where a candidate is up to. 
 Ready before the role opens: talent pools for recurring roles are current, so a new requisition starts with names already in hand. 
 
 Benefits Fully remote, anywhere in India, with no travel. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process. 
 From application to offer: a short written screen, a video interview, a practical exercise (a small mock pipeline to prioritise and a follow-up email to draft), a conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Talent Partner, in about four weeks. 
 Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a process you ran where something nearly slipped: what it was, how you caught it, and what you changed so it could not happen again.

Compliance & Industrial Relations Ensure adherence to labor laws, statutory regulations, and company policies across all plants. Governance HR audit and compliance Respond to queries and data requests on HR processes, systems and practices for customers audits such as Stellantis, Renault Nissan etc.; Ensure compliance and adherence with contractors Coordinate to provide data, information and respond to queries for various internal / external statutory auditors Collate and report on non-compliance / non-adherence to Region HR and determine action plan to close open points/ red flags to ensure compliance Monitor and enhance the operational index rigor for on time execution and smooth operations e.g. merit list, PMS ratings, etc. Review to ensure all statutory and compliance related requirements are met on time and accurately, e.g. upload of licenses by the plant HR, updates on Compliance Management System (CMS), salary updates on contract labour management system, etc. Review, collate and share the monthly compliance review report to the Region HR / employee relations team

description:
Job Summary Position: Sales Lead Build the Sales Engine for Indias Next LegalTech Growth Story. We are building a category-defining LegalTech platform that is transforming how individuals and businesses access legal, compliance, documentation, and dispute-resolution services. We are looking for a Founding Sales Lead who can build and scale our B2C sales organization from the ground up. This is a leadership role for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving revenue, building teams, and owning outcomes. This is not a role where you inherit a large sales organization. You will work directly with the founders to build a scalable customer acquisition engine, establish a high-performing inside sales team, and create a culture focused on conversion, accountability, and growth. Your primary objective will be to drive revenue, improve conversions, and build a sales organization capable of scaling nationally. Key Skills B2C Sales Inside Sales Lead Generation Outbound Sales SDR Team Management Revenue Growth Sales Conversion Customer Acquisition Pipeline Management What Youll Do Build and scale the companys B2C sales function from the ground up. Own monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. Personally engage with key prospects and strategic opportunities. Drive customer acquisition through inside sales and outbound sales channels. Build, manage, and coach SDR, telesales, and inside sales teams. Set up and scale a 30+ member call center operation, including hiring, training, workforce planning, and performance management. Establish team structures, performance metrics, incentive frameworks, and accountability mechanisms. Improve lead qualification, follow-up discipline, and conversion rates. Monitor sales pipeline, team productivity, and revenue performance. Conduct call reviews, coaching sessions, and performance discussions. Collaborate with marketing and operations teams to improve lead quality and customer acquisition efficiency. Help shape the companys go-to-market strategy and sales expansion plans. What Success Looks Like You build a high-performing sales organization that consistently delivers revenue growth. The team is productive, conversion-focused, and capable of handling large lead volumes while maintaining quality customer engagement. We will measure revenue-related metrics including: Revenue achievement Lead-to-customer conversion rate SDR and sales team productivity Call center performance and utilization Pipeline growth and forecast accuracy Team retention and performance improvement Youll Be a Strong Fit If You Have 5+ years of experience in B2C Sales, Business Development, or Inside Sales. Have experience in BFSI, LegalTech, FinTech, Insurance, Lending, or other high-volume consumer sales businesses. Have built or scaled an inside sales function or telesales organization. Have set up and managed a 30+ member call center or sales operation. Have managed SDRs, telesales teams, or inside sales teams. Have personally carried and achieved revenue targets. Can lead from the front while coaching and developing teams. Understand sales funnels, conversion management, and customer acquisition. Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, target-driven environments. Have strong communication, negotiation, and leadership skills. Take ownership of outcomes rather than activities.

description:
Outpace Consulting is looking for dynamic, confident and result-driven HR Recruiters with experience in recruitment or candidate calling. 
 This opportunity is ideal for individuals who enjoy interacting with people, are confident on calls, and have the ability to engage, convince and close candidates. 
 Eligibility & Requirements 
 Graduate in any stream. Minimum 3 months of experience in Recruitment / Candidate Calling. Internship or full-time job experience - both are considered. Strong communication skills in Hindi with basic conversational English. Confident and comfortable with extensive calling and candidate interaction. Good interpersonal, convincing and follow-up skills. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Comfortable working with daily calling and hiring targets. Own laptop and stable internet connection are mandatory. 
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 Enjoys talking to and interacting with people. Has a natural flair for calling and candidate engagement. Can confidently explain opportunities and handle candidate objections. Is proactive, disciplined and self-driven. Can take ownership of assigned hiring requirements. Is comfortable working in a performance-driven environment. Is serious about building a long-term career in recruitment. 
 Role Overview 
 As an HR Recruiter, you will manage the recruitment cycle from candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination, follow-ups, selection and joining closure across multiple hiring requirements. 
 A. Candidate Sourcing & Screening 
 Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, social media, WhatsApp groups, references and other relevant channels. Understand Job Descriptions and hiring requirements. Screen candidates based on experience, eligibility and role requirements. Assess candidates' communication skills and overall suitability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. 
 B. Candidate Calling & Engagement 
 Connect with shortlisted candidates through outbound calls. Explain the job profile, salary, location, shifts, eligibility and selection process. Understand candidate expectations and career requirements. Handle basic queries and objections professionally. Generate candidate interest and drive them towards interviews. 
 C. Interview Coordination & Closure 
 Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews. Maintain regular follow-ups before interviews. Ensure strong interview show-up rates. Track candidate progress through different interview stages. Follow up with selected candidates until joining. Focus on improving selection-to-joining conversion. 
 D. Candidate Management 
 Build professional relationships with candidates. Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process. Provide timely interview and selection updates. Handle candidate dropouts and follow-up requirements. Maintain an organized pipeline of active candidates. 
 E. MIS & Performance Reporting Maintain daily recruitment trackers and MIS. Track calls, screenings, lineups, interviews, selections and joinings. Share daily performance updates with the Team Lead. Work towards assigned recruitment targets and KPIs. Why Join Outpace Consulting? 
 100% Work From Home flexibility. Performance-driven growth opportunities. Hands-on exposure to live recruitment. Opportunity to work across multiple hiring requirements. Strong exposure to candidate sourcing, calling and closure. Fast-paced and learning-oriented work environment. Opportunity to develop practical recruitment and candidate-management skills. 
 This Role Is For You If... 
 You enjoy calling, interacting with people, convincing candidates and achieving hiring targets - and want to build a serious career in recruitment. 
 How to Apply 
 Please apply through Naukri.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team.

While initial outreach through LinkedIn and email is largely automated, you will be responsible for actively calling prospective customers, connecting with decision makers, generating interest, qualifying opportunities, scheduling meetings and consistently following up to progress opportunities towards closure. You will primarily interact with CHROs, HR Heads and other senior HR and business leaders across mid sized and large organizations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with prospective customers, can confidently handle cold calls and objections, and wants to grow from business development into enterprise sales.

Follow up with prospects approached through LinkedIn, email and other outbound campaigns, irrespective of whether they have responded to the initial outreach. Generate interest and qualify prospective customers based on their business requirements. Schedule discovery meetings and product demonstrations with qualified prospects. Respond to prospect queries and maintain regular follow ups throughout the sales cycle. Participate in customer meetings, demos and sales discussions. Follow up after meetings, demos and proposals to ensure clear next steps and maintain momentum. Handle initial objections and nurture prospects until they are ready to progress. Experience with CRM and managing a sales pipeline. Experience in B2B SaaS, HR Tech, Enterprise Software, HR Services or Technology Sales will be preferred.

title: Business Development Lead
description:
Own the whole cycle. Target-account development, outbound prospecting, discovery, solution design, proposal, pilot, negotiation, closure, expansion. All of it. There is no one to hand the baton to halfway. Build a pipeline that doesnt exist yet. Across AI companies, model developers, AI-native businesses, and enterprises building or deploying AI. Youll decide who matters and in what order. Get into rooms with people who decide things. Heads of AI, Heads of Data, CIOs/CDOs, AI Product leaders, and AI Research/Evaluation teams - to find where expert human judgment is genuinely required. Ask better questions than the competition. Consultative discovery to understand the customers specific AI evaluation, validation, training, or domain-expertise gap. Translate fluently in both directions. RLHF, model evaluation, red-teaming, fine-tuning, human-in-the-loop workflows - turned into a business case that works for a research lead and for the executive signing the cheque. Stay honest about what we can deliver. Work closely with our research, expert-sourcing, and delivery teams so that what you propose is commercially viable and operationally real. Selling something we cant build is not a win. Design the deal. Pilot and commercial structures - scope, pricing, success criteria, expansion pathways - built with leadership. Then close it. Own commercial discussions through procurement and contracting, coordinating internally on legal, compliance, data handling, and IP. Dont disappear after signature. Stay close to strategic accounts through delivery, and use client feedback and outcomes to find expansion and repeat business. Bring the market back inside. Feed intelligence into positioning, use cases, pricing, and sales strategy so the playbook keeps improving. Be visible in the ecosystem. Build Infollions presence in AI/ML through the right conversations, networks, events, and communities. Who were looking for - Exposure to B2B sales / business development, with meaningful exposure to complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder transactions. Experience in consultative or solution selling, where understanding the customers problem is central to the sales process - not a step you rush past on the way to the pricing slide. Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through prospecting and outbound business development. Ability to operate in a 0 1 environment and create structure where a mature sales playbook does not yet exist. You will be writing that playbook, mostly by being wrong a few times first. title: Support - Key Account Management
description:
Job Title : Support - Key Account Manager 
 JOB PURPOSE To support the Key Account Management (KAM) function by executing day-to-day account operations, coordinating cross-functional actions for RFQs and ongoing programs, maintaining accurate commercial and delivery data, and ensuring timely, high-quality responses to customer needs thereby enabling the KAMs and the BD organization to achieve revenue, margin, and customer satisfaction goals. 
 PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES 
 1) Account Operations & Customer Support Execute day-to-day account tasks (RFQ trackers, samples dispatch follow-ups, documentation, MOMs) to ensure timely responses to customers and internal teams. Act as the first line of support for routine customer queries and coordinate resolutions with KAM. 2) RFQ & Proposal Coordination Collect customer requirements/specs, liaise with Costing, Engineering, SCM, and Quality, and compile inputs for techno-commercial proposals under KAMs guidance. Maintain RFQ status dashboards, ensure milestones are met, and prepare submission packs. 3) Order Management & Delivery Assurance Track POs/LOIs, schedules, dispatch plans, and deliveries; highlight risks (shortages, logistics holds) and drive cross-functional actions to closure. The Assistant Accounts & Finance Manager will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, banking activities, statutory compliance, receivables/payables and financial controls across the automobile dealership, service workshop and bodyshop operations.
The role requires strong knowledge of automobile dealership accounting, GST, TDS, GST reconciliation, banking, vendor payments, customer collections and MIS reporting .

 A. Accounting & Finance Operations Supervise day-to-day accounting activities and ensure accurate and timely accounting entries. Review purchase, sales, expense, receipt and payment entries. Monitor General Ledger, Journal Entries, Cash Book and Bank Book. Ensure proper accounting of New Car Sales, Used Car Sales, Service, Bodyshop, Spare Parts and Accessories . Review inter-branch/inter-company transactions and reconciliations. Ensure proper accounting and control of dealer incentives, discounts, schemes and claims. B. Verify vendor invoices, supporting documents and approvals before payment. Prepare weekly/monthly outstanding reports. Ensure timely settlement of vendor and customer-related accounts. C. Banking & Cash Management Monitor daily bank transactions and bank balances. Prepare and review bank reconciliation statements. Coordinate NEFT/RTGS/IMPS and other payment transactions. Monitor daily cash collections and deposits. Maintain proper control over cash handling and petty cash. Prepare cash flow requirements and payment planning. D. GST, TDS & Statutory Compliance Ensure timely and accurate GST return preparation and reconciliation . Review GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and related GST workings. Reconcile purchase data with GSTR-2B . Verify GST input tax credit and resolve discrepancies. Ensure TDS deduction, accounting and payment within applicable timelines. Assist in preparation of TDS returns and certificates. Coordinate with consultants/auditors for statutory compliance, notices and assessments. Maintain proper statutory records and supporting documents. E. MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare monthly financial and management reports. Prepare department-wise revenue and expense reports. Prepare P&L-related MIS, outstanding reports, collection reports and expense analysis . Analyze actual expenses against budgets. Prepare branch-wise and department-wise performance reports. Provide financial data and analysis to management for decision-making. Identify unusual expenses, accounting discrepancies and variances. F. Automobile Dealership Accounting 
The candidate should be able to understand and monitor accounting related to: New vehicle sales Used vehicle sales Vehicle stock accounting Vehicle purchase and inventory Dealer incentives and OEM claims Workshop/service revenue Body shop revenue Spare parts inventory Accessories sales Customer advances Vehicle finance and insurance-related transactions Warranty claims and reimbursements Floor-plan/vehicle finance, where applicable Inter-branch vehicle transfers Stock reconciliation G. Inventory & Stock Control Coordinate with Sales, Service, Parts and body shop departments for stock reconciliation. Review vehicle stock and spare-parts accounting. Monitor physical stock versus system records. Identify stock discrepancies and coordinate corrective action. Assist in periodic physical verification and audit. H. Audit & Compliance Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors. Provide required schedules, ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents. Ensure proper documentation and audit trail. Assist in year-end closing and finalization of accounts. Follow company accounting policies and internal financial controls. 3. Team Coordination Supervise and guide Accounts Executives and other junior accounting staff. Coordinate with Sales, Service, Parts, Bodyshop, HR, Administration and Purchase departments . Key Skills Strong accounting knowledge GST & TDS knowledge Financial analysis Bank reconciliation Vendor/customer reconciliation MIS reporting Excellent Excel skills Team management Problem-solving ability Attention to detail Good communication and coordination skills Ability to meet deadlines Strong understanding of financial controls 6. Experience in handling New Car Sales + Service + Bodyshop + Spare Parts accounts will be an added advantage.

title: Sr Analyst SAP GRC (SAP Governance)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. SAP Governance Analyst. This person will play a critical role in ensuring SAP compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX), company policies, and industry best practices. This position is responsible for supporting the development of SAP standards and operating procedures, designing, executing, and enforcing SAP IT internal controls (e.g., user access reviews, change reviews), training stakeholders on SAP compliance requirements, developing SAP governance strategies, managing risks, and improving operational efficiencies.
The ideal candidate will be proactive, hands-on, and results oriented. 
 MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Develop and implement SAP policies, procedures, and guidelines, review exception requests, and oversee enforcement.
• Design and govern role-based access control strategies for SAP systems; provide clear guidance for the SAP Security team. Define and propose data protection and privacy protocols such as encryption and masking.
• Develop and maintain SAP internal controls environment documentation (e.g., process flows, narratives, control matrices, segregation of duties rulesets, role security matrices, etc.).
• Monitor compliance to the end-to-end SAP user access lifecycle, including role assignment, segregation of duties conflict management, approvals, periodic access reviews, and deprovisioning as well as the elevated access management process. Propose process improvements and security enhancements. Execute controls.
• Design, implement, and monitor SAP system adherence to software development lifecycle, job monitoring, and other applicable SAP controls. Ensure secure system parameters are defined and configured.
• Assist with the development of corrective action plans to address SAP internal control deficiencies and the timely remediation of the deficiencies.
• Define and enforce SAP role design and maintenance, including role and authorization object creation, revision, testing, and disablement.
• Respond to SAP Security-related incidents.
• Maintain segregation of duties ruleset in accordance with business process requirements and enforce rules that prevent conflicts of interest.
• Mature the overall SAP controls environment; drive towards automation and continuous monitoring practices.
• Prepare for and facilitate internal and external audits, gathering and providing required documentation and evidence of compliance.
• Provide training and guidance regarding SAP policies, control procedures, and tools to control owners, role owners/access approvers, and system end users.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop, implement, and remediate SAP processes and controls. Develop and manage relationships with IT and cross-functional stakeholders. Work with cross-functional teams and SAP architects to embed security into all SAP projects.
• Track and manage key performance indicators; generate dashboards and reports needed to effectively communicate SAP security risks, segregation of duties conflicts, and other compliance metrics.
• Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS
 Education
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Engineering, Accounting, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Certification / Licensure
 Work Experience: 
• Total 5 + Years and 3+ or more years of experience in Internal Controls, SAP Security, SAP Administration, IT Internal Audit, and/or Information Security
• Must have experience working in a large and complex SAP environment
• Must have experience with Sarbanes-Oxley compliance
Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
 Familiarity with using modern GRC or other workflow tools to effectively manage SAP controls execution
• In-depth understanding of IT internal controls (i.e., Change Management, Access, IT Operations, segregation of duties rulesets, SDLC)
• Experience developing and maintaining internal controls documentation (e.g., risk control matrices, narratives, process flows, etc.)
• Strong written and verbal skills, including a demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical information into concepts that are easily understood
• Strong analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking skills, including the ability to anticipate issues and to design appropriate solutions
• Excellent teamwork skills
• Detail and deadline oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously with limited supervision
• Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio)

High-AOV considered purchase categories. Long consideration windows change attribution, creative and bidding all at once.

 Salary: As per company standards About the Role QHT Clinic is looking for a creative and enthusiastic Photographer cum Videographer to join our Creative and Marketing team. The role will involve creating high-quality visual content for our clinics, doctors, patients, treatments, social media platforms, marketing campaigns, and brand communication. The ideal candidate should have a good eye for composition, lighting, framing, visual storytelling, and short-form video content , along with a strong interest in photography and videography. Key Responsibilities Capture high-quality photographs of doctors, staff, patients/models, clinic interiors, procedures, treatments, products, and events. Shoot before-and-after photographs while following company guidelines and patient privacy requirements. Record high-quality videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube, social media, marketing campaigns, doctor content, and educational content. Plan and execute photo and video shoots at clinics and other locations. Handle cameras, lighting, tripods, microphones, backdrops, and other photography/videography equipment. Coordinate with doctors, patients/models, content writers, graphic designers, and video editors during shoots. Capture behind-the-scenes content, testimonials, interviews, clinic activities, and promotional content. Assist with framing, lighting, camera angles, and shot composition during video shoots. Perform basic photo and video editing, including cropping, colour correction, transitions, retouching, and optimisation. Create social-media-ready photographs and videos in appropriate formats and dimensions. Organise, rename, store, and maintain photography and video files systematically. Assist the Creative Team with content concepts, references, mood boards, and shoot planning. Maintain proper handling and care of photography and videography equipment. Stay updated with current photography, videography, Reels, and social media content trends. Support the Creative Team with other visual-content requirements as required. Required Skills Basic understanding of photography, composition, framing, exposure, and lighting. Basic knowledge of DSLR/Mirrorless cameras and photography equipment. Basic understanding of videography, camera movements, framing, and lighting. Knowledge of Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar editing tools . Good visual sense and attention to detail. Creativity and willingness to experiment with different photography and video styles. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to work on-site and manage multiple shoot requirements. Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced healthcare and creative environment. Preferred Qualifications Freshers or candidates with 0-1 year of relevant experience may apply. Diploma/degree/course in Photography, Mass Communication, Visual Arts, Multimedia, Film, Design, or a related field will be an advantage. Personal, college, freelance, or social-media photography/videography portfolio will be preferred. Experience creating Instagram Reels, short-form videos, or YouTube content will be an added advantage. Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is creative, observant, responsible, eager to learn, and passionate about photography and videography , with the ability to understand creative briefs and convert them into engaging visual content. Portfolio: Candidates are encouraged to share their photography/videography portfolio, Instagram page, YouTube channel, or sample work along with their application.

 xFanatical is a software company headquartered in California, United States, and it started its operations in 2019. Safe Doc creates a safe space for students by removing illicit content, whereas Foresight ensures that complex tasks are automated and simplified. 
 Our flagship products ensure they comply with rules and regulations, simplify operations by automating workflows, and bring efficiency and optimum performance. Our target audience includes businesses, schools, and enterprises using Google Workspace, and we ensure they get nothing but the best. Were one of the most authentic partners of Google Cloud, and our domain knowledge in Google Workspace gives us an edge over our competitors. Our company is known to push boundaries of eminence, and our team settles for nothing less than greatness. At our core, we value integrity and inclusivity and ensure that our employees get a work-life balance. At xFanatical, we are committed to delivering trust and committed solutions that keep you two steps ahead of your competitors digitally. Our team provides cutting-edge solutions to our customers so that they derive maximum benefits from the Google Workspace ecosystem. 
 About the role We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer as a Digital Marketing Specialist to join our software development team. As a Technical Writer, you will play a crucial role in creating and maintaining high-quality documentation that helps our customers and internal teams understand and utilize our software products effectively. 
 In this role, you will be responsible for: Documentation Development: Create, edit, and maintain comprehensive documentation for our software products, including user guides, API documentation, installation guides, release notes, and FAQs. Develop content that explains complex technical information in a clear, concise, and accurate manner. Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, product managers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders to gather information and understand the functionality and requirements of the software. Participate in product design and development meetings to gain a deep understanding of the product and contribute to usability improvements. Content Management: Organize and manage documentation.. Ensure documentation is up-to-date with the latest software releases and features. User-Centric Approach: Focus on the needs of the end-users to create user-friendly documentation that enhances the overall user experience. Incorporate user feedback to continuously improve the quality and usability of documentation. Standards and Guidelines: Establish and maintain documentation standards and best practices to ensure consistency and quality across all documentation. Adhere to company guidelines and industry standards for technical writing. Training and Support: Assist in the creation of training materials and tutorials for internal teams and customers. Provide support for documentation-related inquiries and issues. Skills and experience required for this role: Bachelors degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science or Engineering. 3-5 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer in the software or other technology industries. Demonstrated knowledge of SEO and web traffic metrics is a requirement for this role. Strong technical background with the ability to understand and explain complex concepts. Ability to translate technical information into clear, user-friendly language for a non-technical audience. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a keen eye for detail. Proficiency in documentation tools and software, such as Google Docs, Wordpress, or other relevant platforms. Familiarity with version control systems and documentation best practices. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. 
 Why Join xFanatical? Work in a dynamic tech environment with a focus on Digital Marketing. Gain hands-on experience in content strategy, social media, and SEO. Be part of a collaborative team with opportunities to grow and develop your comprehensive marketing knowledge. Competitive salary and performance-based incentives and raises. Health insurance coverage for you and your family. Work remotely from anywhere comfortable, saving commute time and cost. Flexible working hours for a healthy work-life balance. Floating holidays for your cultural and personal preferences.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Finance, Accounting, Operations, and Business teams to ensure accurate tax treatment of transactions. Required Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field. 46 years of relevant experience in U.S. Sales and Use Tax compliance. Experience developing and executing control test plans, and reporting on control effectiveness and improvement opportunities. title: Sr Controllership Analyst
description:
Sr. Controllership Analyst - Contract Reviews position is responsible for performing technical accounting reviews of customer contracts, proposals, amendments, and other commercial arrangements across multiple business segments. The role ensures consistent application of U. S. GAAP, including ASC 606, and Honeywell accounting policies; evaluates revenue recognition and project accounting implications; and maintains high standards of documentation, accounting compliance, and internal control. The position partners closely with Controllership, Finance, Legal, Commercial, and business leadership to translate contract terms into clear accounting conclusions and practical guidance. The individual is a key member of the controllership team and a trusted advisor to regional and global business and finance leaders. Basic Qualifications: - 4+ years of accounting, controllership, audit, or finance experience, including technical accounting, revenue recognition, project accounting, or business controls - CA, CMA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification Preferred Qualifications: - Prior experience with any Big 4 consulting firm, preferably serving multinational, industrial, or complex revenue-recognition clients - Demonstrated experience applying U. S. GAAP and ASC 606 to customer contracts, revenue arrangements, or long-term projects - Experience with technical accounting research and documentation; SAP, Hyperion, or similar ERP and reporting tools is advantageous We Value: Strong technical accounting judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to analyze complex contracts and reach well-supported conclusions Ability to explain accounting requirements in practical business language and influence stakeholders across Finance, Legal, Commercial, and Operations Strong attention to detail, documentation discipline, and ownership of deadlines in a high-volume, multi-region environment Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive communication and effective delivery of technical accounting training Knowledge of U. S. GAAP, ASC 606, long-term project accounting, internal controls, and accounting policy application; public accounting experience is a plus Ability to work independently, escalate significant issues appropriately, and make decisions within established policy and consultation frameworks Collaborative, self-motivated, and committed to strengthening controls, standardizing processes, and improving the efficiency and quality of contract reviews Key Responsibilities: Lead timely, risk-based reviews of customer contracts, purchase orders, proposals, amendments, change orders, and related commercial arrangements for compliance with U. S. GAAP, ASC 606, corporate accounting policies, and applicable statutory requirements. Apply the ASC 606 five-step model to identify contracts and performance obligations, determine and allocate transaction price, and conclude on the timing and method of revenue recognition. Assess complex or non-standard provisions, including termination and cancellation rights, variable consideration, liquidated damages, acceptance clauses, warranties, payment terms, significant financing, principal-versus-agent considerations, and contract modifications. Evaluate project accounting implications, including point-in-time versus over-time recognition, measures of progress, contract costs, change orders, unbilled receivables, advances, loss provisions, and other judgmental matters. Prepare and review revenue recognition checklists, technical accounting memo, white papers, consultation documentation, and clearly supported accounting conclusions. Partner with Finance, Legal, Commercial, Project Management, and business teams before contract execution to interpret key provisions, identify accounting risks, and recommend practical contract language or mitigating actions. Provide clear accounting guidance and training to business and finance stakeholders on U. S. GAAP, ASC 606, project accounting, and corporate accounting policies. Administer accounting policies, coordinate significant or unusual matters with regional, SBU, SBG, and Corporate Controllership teams. Ensure contract-review processes and related internal controls are consistently executed, supported by sufficient evidence, and retained in accordance with governance requirements. Identify control or process gaps, support corrective action plans, monitor remediation, and drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement in the contract-review process. Support monthly and quarterly close activities by resolving contract-related accounting matters and reviewing significant judgments, journal entries, balance-sheet impacts, and disclosure considerations. Support internal and external audits, respond to technical accounting inquiries, and assist Controllership and Finance with special projects and emerging business models.

description:
