This function manages enterprise data platforms, data access, governance, reporting, business intelligence solutions, and advanced analytics capabilities. Data Engineering is responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable data platforms that enable efficient data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and consumption across the enterprise. As part of the Platform Engineering team, this role focuses on delivering reliable, secure, automated, and scalable data infrastructure supporting business-critical analytics and data products. The ideal candidate will contribute to platform operations, cloud-based data engineering solutions, CI/CD automation, and production support while partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure a stable and high-performing data ecosystem. Qualifications 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or related technical roles. 2-4 years of experience in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or DevOps. Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark is required. Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms is required. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools is required. Strong experience with SQL, Python, and PySpark. Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and source control best practices is required. Experience supporting production environments and platform operations. Understanding of Infrastructure as Code concepts (Terraform preferred). Familiarity with monitoring, observability, security, and governance practices. Key Responsibilities Support and enhance Databricks-based enterprise data platform solutions. Develop, deploy, and optimize data processing workloads using Databricks and Spark. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate deployment and platform operations. Monitor platform performance, reliability, and availability. Investigate and resolve platform incidents, deployment failures, and operational issues. Contribute to platform modernization, automation, and cloud optimization initiatives. Collaborate with Data Engineers, Architects, and Product teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities. Support governance, security, and operational compliance requirements. Create and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures. What Is Expected of You and Others at This Level Works independently on moderately complex assignments. Demonstrates strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities. Contributes to platform reliability and operational improvement initiatives. Supports automation and DevOps adoption across platform engineering processes. Partners effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Takes ownership of assigned deliverables and operational outcomes. Preferred Technical Skills Databricks (Workflows, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) Apache Spark / PySpark Harness CI/CD Pipelines Python SQL Azure Data Platform, GCP, or AWS Git/GitHub Terraform Monitoring and Observability Tools DevOps & Platform Engineering Practices Incident and Production Support Management Work Schedule This role is part of the global Data Engineering Platform Operations team and requires participation in a rotational shift schedule to ensure support coverage across multiple regions and time zones. Team members will also be required to provide weekend support on a rotational basis, approximately one weekend per month . A compensatory day off will be provided for weekend support. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working in the following shifts based on business requirements: 
 Morning Shift: 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM Afternoon Shift: 1:00 PM - 10:00 PM Evening Shift: 5:30 PM - 2:30 AM The shift schedule may vary depending on operational and business needs. Additional Expectations Participate in rotational production support and platform operations activities. Monitor and support Databricks environments, data pipelines, CI/CD deployments, and platform services. Respond to platform incidents, service disruptions, deployment failures, and operational requests within defined SLAs. Collaborate effectively with globally distributed platforms, engineering, and business teams. Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with modern data platforms, cloud technologies, Databricks, DevOps practices, and enterprise-scale data engineering operations.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities VPRC is looking for a dynamic and experienced Manager Finance to manage the company's day-to-day financial operations, cash flow, fund allocation, accounting, budgeting, financial reporting and internal controls. 
 The role will be responsible for ensuring financial discipline, optimum utilization of funds, timely reporting and effective financial controls, while providing accurate financial information to management for business decision-making. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Fund & Cash Flow Management Monitor VPRC's daily cash position and fund requirements. Prepare regular cash flow statements and forecasts. Plan and monitor fund allocation based on business priorities. Ensure optimum utilization of available funds. Monitor incoming and outgoing payments and maintain adequate liquidity. Identify potential cash-flow gaps and escalate them to management. Coordinate with management for major financial commitments and payments. 
 2. Financial Accounting & Reporting Supervise day-to-day accounting activities. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions. Review ledgers, bank reconciliations and accounting entries. Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing. Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. 
 3. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly Finance MIS for management review. Provide reports on revenue, expenses, cash flow, receivables and payables. Prepare budget-versus-actual analysis. Highlight significant financial variances and cost deviations. Provide financial data and analysis to support management decisions. 
 4. Budgeting & Cost Control Assist in preparation of the annual financial budget. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets. Identify unnecessary expenditure and cost-control opportunities. Ensure expenses are incurred within approved limits and authorization processes. Review major expenditure proposals from a financial perspective. 
 5. Receivables & Payables Management Monitor outstanding receivables and payment collections. Prepare and review ageing reports. Coordinate with relevant teams regarding overdue payments. Monitor vendor liabilities and payment schedules. Ensure payments are planned according to cash availability and business priorities. 
 6. Internal Financial Controls Implement and monitor effective financial control procedures. Ensure proper authorization for expenses, purchases and payments. Verify supporting documents before processing financial transactions. Identify financial control gaps and recommend corrective measures. Ensure adherence to VPRC's finance policies and approval procedures. 
 7. Audit & Statutory Compliance Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and consultants. Ensure timely preparation of audit schedules and supporting documents. Support statutory compliance relating to GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable requirements. Ensure timely closure of audit observations. Maintain proper documentation for statutory and financial records. 
 8. Banking & Treasury Operations Manage banking transactions and relationships with banks. Monitor bank balances, payments and collections. Review bank reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with banks for routine financial requirements. Monitor interest costs, banking charges and other financial expenses. 
 9. Team Management Supervise the Finance & Accounts team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor deliverables. Establish timelines for accounting, reconciliations, MIS and reporting. Ensure accuracy and timely completion of finance activities. Develop a culture of financial discipline and process adherence. 
 Key Deliverables Accurate and timely monthly Finance MIS. Effective cash-flow monitoring and forecasting. Proper fund allocation and utilization. Timely accounting and financial closing. Strong receivables and payables monitoring. Effective budget and cost control. Robust internal financial controls. Timely statutory and audit compliance. Reliable financial information for management. 
 Qualification Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory Candidates who have completed their CA qualification with relevant post-qualification experience will be preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, financial reporting, cash-flow management and financial controls is essential. 
 Experience 15 to 20 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably with significant post-qualification experience as a Chartered Accountant. Proven experience in fund management, cash-flow planning, budgeting, MIS, financial reporting and internal controls. Experience independently managing finance operations and working closely with senior management is preferred. 
 CORE COMPETENCIES Fund Management & Cash Flow Planning Financial Planning & Analysis Budgeting & Cost Control Financial Reporting & MIS Working Capital Management Statutory Compliance & Taxation Internal Controls & Audit Banking & Treasury Operations Financial Risk Management Advanced MS Excel and ERP/Accounting Systems Strong analytical and commercial understanding High level of integrity, accuracy and financial discipline 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on finance professional who can independently manage VPRC's financial operations, maintain strong financial controls, provide clear MIS to management and ensure that funds are planned, allocated and utilized efficiently. The candidate should have the ability to identify financial risks early, bring discipline to financial processes and support management with accurate, timely and actionable financial information.

Key Skills: Budgetary Control,Strategic Financial Planning,Funds Flow Management,Cash Flow Management,Financial Management,Fund Management,Budget Management,Cost Planning

Only for Male Candidate JOB DESCRIPTION - Executive Associate to the Founder Work Mode: Hybrid (Field + Office) Office Locations: Defence Colony & Kailash Colony, New Delhi Employment Type: Full-Time Preferred Candidate: Male About the Role This is not a conventional Personal Assistant position. The Executive Associate will work directly with the Founder, acting as an extension of the executive office while supporting daily business operations, client coordination, project management, documentation, travel, and strategic execution. This role offers direct exposure to consulting, business management, executive decisionmaking, operations, project coordination, and client relationship management. It is ideal for individuals who wish to build a long-term career in business operations and leadership. Key Responsibilities - Executive Support • Assist the Founder during meetings, business discussions, presentations and client interactions. • Accompany the Founder on official meetings, site visits and business travel whenever required. • Manage calendars, appointments and schedules. • Prepare meeting files, reports and required documents. • Maintain daily execution trackers and task management systems. • Ensure timely completion of commitments and follow-ups. Meeting & Project Coordination • Schedule meetings with clients, consultants and internal teams. • Prepare meeting agendas. • Record professional Minutes of Meeting (MOM). • Share action points with stakeholders. • Monitor progress of assigned tasks. • Coordinate project timelines and deliverables. Client Relationship Management • Maintain professional communication with clients. • Coordinate drawings, layouts, photographs and project documentation. • Share project updates. • Ensure smooth communication between internal teams and clients. Office Administration When the Founder is travelling or attending field assignments, the Executive Associate will independently coordinate office operations. Responsibilities include: • Managing office workflow • Coordinating designers, draftsmen and consultants • Maintaining project files • Organising digital and physical documentation • Handling official emails and correspondence • Coordinating with vendors and service providers Accounts & Documentation • Coordinate pending payment follow-ups. • Maintain invoice records. • Coordinate with accounts department. • Maintain business documentation. • Ensure accurate filing of project information. Travel Coordination • Assist with official travel planning. • Coordinate travel schedules. • Maintain travel documentation. • Be available for business travel whenever required. Learning Opportunities This position offers practical exposure to: • Business Consulting • Executive Management • Client Relationship Management • Project Coordination • Operations Management • Business Documentation • Strategic Planning • Leadership Development Desired Skills • Excellent communication skills in Hindi and English • Strong written communication • Professional etiquette • Excellent organisational abilities • Strong planning and execution skills • Ability to multitask • High attention to detail • Microsoft Office & Google Workspace proficiency • Basic understanding of AutoCAD or technical drawings (preferred) • Ability to maintain confidentiality • Positive attitude and problem-solving mindset Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is: • Honest and trustworthy • Highly disciplined • Professionally presented • Punctual and dependable • Calm under pressure • Quick to learn • Detail-oriented • Comfortable working in dynamic environments • Flexible with work schedules • Willing to travel whenever required • Capable of representing the company professionally Why Join Shubh Aakar Energy? Joining Shubh Aakar Energy means becoming part of a dynamic consulting environment where every day offers new learning opportunities. You will receive: • Direct mentorship from the Founder • Exposure to real-world business operations • Opportunities to work with premium residential, commercial and industrial projects • Experience across consulting, design coordination and business management • Long-term career growth based on performance • A professional and entrepreneurial work environment Working Model Hybrid Working • Field assignments with the Founder around Delhi NCR, International and Domestic. • Office responsibilities from Kailash Colony when not travelling • Reporting point for field work: Defence Colony • Official travel expenses borne by the company Who Should Apply? This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking more than a routine office role. If you enjoy solving problems, coordinating people, managing projects, learning directly from experienced leadership, travelling, and taking ownership of responsibilities, this position offers exceptional professional exposure and long-term career growth. Why This Role Matters At Shubh Aakar Energy Private Limited, every project begins with detailed site visits, client discussions, technical observations, and strategic planning. During these visits, the Founder works closely with clients, architects, consultants, contractors, and project teams to understand project requirements, identify practical solutions, and recommend design or planning modifications. The Executive Associate plays a critical role in ensuring that these discussions are accurately documented and translated into clear, structured, and implementation-ready outputs. This position acts as the bridge between on-site consultations and the final deliverables provided to clients. The selected candidate will carefully understand discussions, observations, sketches, and instructions shared during meetings and site visits, and convert them into professional written documentation, AutoCAD mark-ups, project notes, requirement sheets, and other structured formats that can be easily understood by clients, architects, designers, and execution teams. AutoCAD & Documentation Responsibilities AutoCAD proficiency is an important part of this role because most client discussions and site recommendations ultimately need to be reflected on architectural drawings. The Executive Associate will not be expected to independently design projects, but will work closely with the Founder to accurately translate discussions and recommendations into updated AutoCAD drawings. The ability to convert technical discussions into organised documentation and visually understandable drawings is one of the most valuable aspects of this position. It enables seamless communication between the consulting team, clients, architects, contractors, and execution teams while ensuring every recommendation can be implemented accurately and efficiently. Job Description We are looking for an experienced, responsible and highly accountable Senior Accountant / Accounts In-Charge who can independently manage the day-to-day accounting, statutory compliance, banking, receivables, payables and inventory-related accounting of the company. The candidate should be hands-on, systematic, disciplined and responsible for the accuracy, completeness and timely completion of all assigned accounting work . Key Responsibilities Handle complete day-to-day accounting of the company. Prepare and file GST Returns , including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST compliances. Reconcile GST input/output and ensure correctness of GST records. Handle TDS calculations, deductions, payments and TDS returns . Perform daily bank reconciliation for all company bank accounts. Monitor bank entries and ensure that all receipts and payments are properly accounted for. Prepare sales invoices, tax invoices, debit notes and credit notes. Handle e-Invoicing and E-Way Bills , wherever applicable. Check invoices for correct rates, quantities, GST and other commercial details. Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. Perform regular customer and vendor reconciliation . Monitor outstanding receivables and prepare customer ageing reports. Follow up internally regarding overdue customer payments. Maintain and verify accounts payable and accounts receivable. Ensure that purchases, sales and expenses are correctly booked under appropriate accounting heads. Reconcile stock/inventory records with accounts . Verify incoming stock, purchase entries and supporting documents. Ensure that stock received is properly entered against the relevant Purchase Order / GRN / supplier invoice. Identify discrepancies between physical stock, software stock and accounting records. Maintain proper accounting records for the concerned company/business entity. Conduct ledger scrutiny and identify incorrect, duplicate or missing entries. Prepare monthly accounting reports and reconciliations. Assist in month-end and year-end closing. Coordinate with CA / auditors for GST, TDS, statutory compliance and audit requirements. Maintain complete supporting documentation and proper filing of accounting records. Ensure that statutory payments and returns are completed before their respective due dates. Daily End-of-Day Reporting Mandatory The Accounts In-Charge will be required to submit a Daily End-of-Day Accounts Report before leaving the office . The daily report should clearly mention: Bank reconciliation status. Payments received from customers. Payments made to suppliers and other parties. Customer outstanding / overdue payment status. Invoices generated during the day. Purchase entries completed. Debit notes / credit notes issued or pending. GST / TDS work completed or pending. Stock or inventory discrepancies noticed. Customer / supplier reconciliation completed. Any accounting issue, discrepancy or pending approval. Work completed during the day. Work pending at the end of the day. Reason for any pending work. Priority work planned for the next working day. No important accounting work should remain pending without being mentioned in the Daily End-of-Day Report. Accountability & Ownership This position requires a person who takes complete ownership and accountability for the assigned work . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that: Assigned work is completed within the required timeline. Accounting entries are accurate and supported by proper documents. GST and TDS compliances are completed correctly and on time. Bank reconciliation is updated regularly. Customer outstanding is properly monitored. Customer and vendor ledgers are properly reconciled. Stock received and stock appearing in accounts/software are properly matched. Mistakes, discrepancies or missing documents are identified and reported immediately. Incorrect or incomplete information is not ignored. Pending work is reported clearly instead of being carried forward without explanation. Management is informed immediately if any issue can affect accounts, taxation, payments, customer outstanding or statutory compliance. Daily reports reflect the actual status of work and should not contain incorrect or misleading information. description:

 EHS, Compliance & Safety Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS and statutory requirements, including TNPCB, DISH, Fire & Rescue Services, CEIG, DTCP and other regulatory authorities. Manage statutory licenses, consents, approvals, renewals, registers, inspections and regulatory submissions. Implement and maintain ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, including internal/external audits, management reviews and CAPA closure. Lead HIRA, JSA, Permit-to-Work, LOTO, contractor safety and high-risk activity controls . Drive accident prevention, SIF/Fatality Prevention , safety inspections, near-miss reporting and proactive safety programs. Manage applicable EPR compliance , authorized waste vendors and environmental documentation. Drive energy efficiency, GHG emission reduction, renewable energy, water conservation, recycling and waste-reduction initiatives . About TMF Group TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing globally. We focus on providing specialized and business-critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds in different geographical locations. TMF India is a Great Place to Work, ISO ISAE certified organization. Discover the Role The Identity Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, administration, and continuous improvement of Identity and Access Management solutions across the organization. The role focuses on ensuring secure access to enterprise systems through effective identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorization, and user provisioning processes. The IAM Engineer works closely with HR, Cybersecurity, IT Operations, Application Owners, and business stakeholders to manage user access, automate Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes, support compliance requirements, and maintain IAM platforms. Key Responsibilities 

 Identity Access Management Engineering 
 Configure, administer, and support IAM and Identity Governance (IGA) platforms. Support onboarding of applications into IAM solutions. Configure connectors, workflows, roles, entitlements, and approval processes. Implement and maintain identity lifecycle management processes. Support automation of Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) activities. Strengthen Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance frameworks. Troubleshoot provisioning failures, synchronization issues, and IAM integrations. 

 User Access Management 
 Provision, modify, and deprovision user access across enterprise applications. Manage access requests and entitlement assignments. Ensure access activities comply with security policies and standards. Support privileged access and segregation of duties controls. 

 Authentication Access Services 
 Support Single Sign-On (SSO) implementations. Assist with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) administration. Manage authentication and authorization integrations. Support identity directories and federation services. 

 Governance, Risk Compliance 
 Support access review and certification campaigns. Collect and maintain audit evidence. Assist with compliance assessments and remediation activities. Ensure IAM controls align with organizational and regulatory requirements. 

 BAU Operations Support 
 Resolve IAM incidents, service requests, and operational issues. Monitor IAM queues, connectors, workflows, and system health. Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles. Meet service level agreements (SLAs) for IAM activities. 

 Stakeholder Engagement 
 Collaborate with HR, IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Application Owners, and business teams. Communicate access-related risks, issues, and requirements effectively. Support project delivery and identity governance initiatives. Work effectively within global and cross-functional teams. 

 Continuous Improvement 
 Identify opportunities for process automation and optimization. Support IAM platform enhancements and security improvements. Stay updated on IAM technologies, emerging security risks, and industry best practices. Key Requirements 

 Experience 
 3+ years of experience in: Identity Access Management (IAM) Identity Governance Administration (IGA) IT Security Access Management Cybersecurity Operations 

 IAM IGA Platforms 
 Hands-on experience with one or more of: SailPoint Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Saviynt Okta Ping Identity Similar IAM/IGA solutions 

 Identity Lifecycle Management 
 Strong understanding of: Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes User onboarding User transfers and role changes User offboarding Access revocation and certification 

 Access Management 
 Experience with: User provisioning and deprovisioning Access request management Entitlement management Access reviews and certifications Privileged access concepts 

 Authentication Authorization 
 Knowledge of: Single Sign-On (SSO) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) SAML OAuth OpenID Connect (OIDC) LDAP Active Directory / Entra ID 

 Access Governance 
 Understanding of: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Birthright Access Segregation of Duties (SoD) Access Governance Controls Compliance and Audit Requirements 

 Technical Skills 
 Preferred exposure to: PowerShell SQL REST APIs Automation and scripting Directory synchronization IAM connectors and integrations What s in it for you Pathways for career development Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work. We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF. Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy. Through our corporate social responsibility program, you ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work. A supportive environment Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace. Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey. Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work-life balance to perform at your best. At TMF Group, it s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability. title: Associate Director - Motherhub Ops
description:
Position Overview The Assistant Director Motherhub Operations will be responsible for managing and overseeing end-to-end warehouse operations across Mother Hubs, ensuring operational efficiency, cost optimization, inventory accuracy, and adherence to service-level agreements. The role involves managing warehouse infrastructure, manpower, inventory movement, and logistics coordination while driving productivity, process improvements, and operational excellence. The incumbent will work closely with regional operations, supply chain, procurement, finance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless warehouse functioning and achievement of business objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Warehouse Operations Oversee end-to-end Motherhub operations, including inbound, putaway, storage, inventory management, picking, dispatch, and outbound activities. Ensure smooth functioning of warehouse operations across FMCG, Fruits & Vegetables (F&V), and cold-chain warehouses, as applicable. Drive operational efficiency, throughput, productivity, and adherence to defined service-level agreements. Ensure optimal utilization of warehouse infrastructure, storage capacity, and operational resources. Monitor daily operational performance and resolve bottlenecks to ensure uninterrupted warehouse functioning. 2. Operational Excellence & Productivity Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance warehouse productivity, operational efficiency, and process adherence. Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement. Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure compliance with established operational processes. Monitor key operational metrics, including order processing time, inventory accuracy, throughput, and manpower productivity. Lead initiatives to improve turnaround time, reduce operational errors, and enhance overall warehouse performance. 3. Cost Management & Optimization Drive cost efficiency across warehouse operations, including fixed costs, rentals, manpower, operational expenditure, and logistics costs. Monitor warehouse-level costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality. Ensure effective manpower planning and optimal deployment of resources in line with business requirements. Partner with Finance and Procurement teams to monitor budgets, control operational expenses, and drive cost-saving initiatives. Identify and address cost leakages, operational inefficiencies, and resource utilization gaps. 4. Inventory & Process Management Ensure inventory accuracy through effective stock management, cycle counts, and reconciliation processes. Monitor inventory movement, stock availability, damages, wastage, and expiry management. Establish controls to minimize inventory losses, shrinkage, and operational discrepancies. Ensure adherence to quality, safety, hygiene, and storage standards across warehouses. For F&V and cold-chain operations, ensure appropriate handling, temperature control, and product quality standards. 5. Team & Stakeholder Management Lead and manage warehouse operations teams, including Managers, Team Leads, and frontline associates. Build a strong performance-driven culture focused on ownership, accountability, productivity, and operational discipline. Drive workforce planning, capability development, and performance management across the team. Collaborate with regional operations, central supply chain, transportation, procurement, finance, and other relevant stakeholders. Ensure effective coordination across functions to support business continuity and operational requirements. 6. Performance Monitoring & Reporting Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly warehouse performance against defined operational targets. Develop and review performance dashboards covering productivity, cost, inventory accuracy, service levels, and manpower utilization. Provide regular business updates, highlight operational challenges, and recommend corrective actions. Drive timely closure of operational issues through structured reviews and action plans. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and operational governance requirements. 7. Strategic Planning & Business Support Support warehouse capacity planning, network expansion, and infrastructure-related initiatives. Partner with business and central teams to align warehouse capabilities with business growth and demand requirements. Drive operational readiness for new warehouse launches, capacity expansion, and process transitions. Evaluate operational requirements and recommend improvements in warehouse layout, processes, and resource planning. Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on scalability, service quality, and overall supply chain efficiency. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Warehouse operational efficiency and productivity. Cost per unit and cost per order. Inbound and outbound turnaround time. Inventory accuracy and reconciliation compliance. Manpower productivity and resource utilization. Order fulfilment and dispatch SLA adherence. Warehouse capacity utilization. Reduction in damages, wastage, shrinkage, and operational losses. Safety, quality, and process compliance. Achievement of operational and cost-saving targets. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Commerce, or a related field. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Operations/Supply Chain Management is preferred. 8–12 years of experience in warehouse operations, supply chain, logistics, or distribution management. Proven experience managing large-scale warehouse or Motherhub operations. Experience handling multiple operational functions, including inbound, outbound, inventory management, manpower planning, and logistics coordination. Demonstrated experience in operational planning, cost management, productivity improvement, and process optimization. Experience managing large teams and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders. Exposure to FMCG, grocery, F&V, or cold-chain warehouse operations would be an advantage. Skills & Competencies Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse and supply chain operations. Excellent people management, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to drive operational excellence and process improvements. Strong commercial acumen and cost optimization capabilities. Data-driven approach with proficiency in MS Excel, dashboards, and operational reporting tools. Strong communication, decision-making, and execution skills. High ownership, accountability, and ability to manage dynamic operational environments.

title: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre
description:
About DP World Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the worlds trade flow better, changing whats possible for the customers and communities we serve globally. With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain thats fit for the future. We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades. What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door. 
 About DP World Global Service Centre DP World’s Global Service Centre (GSCs) are key enablers of growth delivering standardization, process excellence and expertise, and automation in areas of Finance, Freight Forwarding, Marine Services, Engineering and Human Resources, helping accelerate DP World’s growth and business transformation. As we experience exponential growth, there has never been a more exciting time to join us. Discover your next role here and change what's possible for everyone! As an equal employer that recognizes and values diversity and an inclusive culture, we empower and up-skill our people with opportunities to perform at their best. Join us and be part of an amazing team that is transforming the future of world trade. 
 Role Purpose Lead the end-to-end design and transition of work from regions into the GSC, shaping sustainable delivery solutions from target operating model, organization and team structure, capacity and skill requirements, governance and controls through knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live and stabilization. Independently partner with regional and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions and ensure controlled, transparent and successful transitions.
 
 Designation: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre Department – Business Process Base Location: Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai Reporting To: Vice President 
 Key Role Responsibilities Collaborate independently with regional stakeholders and GSC functional owners to understand business objectives, process scope, pain points, volumes, service expectations, controls and dependencies. Design end-to-end GSC / offshoring solutions, including target operating model, team structure, spans and layers, capacity, skill mix, governance and charge back. Translate the agreed solution into detailed process scope, resource requirements, implementation approach, dependencies, assumptions, service levels, controls and measurable business outcomes. Apply strong knowledge of GSC, shared services and offshoring models, transition methodologies, process design, operational controls and industry best practices to develop practical and scalable solutions. Act as a trusted advisor and primary transition / solutioning partner to senior regional and functional stakeholders, independently leading discussions, workshops, negotiations and decision-making forums. Communicate solution options, trade-offs, risks, dependencies and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders; constructively challenge assumptions where required to protect transition and operational outcomes. Collaborate with GSC leadership, operations, process owners, HR, finance, technology, Process Excellence and other enabling functions to validate solution feasibility and ensure end-to-end implementation readiness. Define clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights and governance across regional and GSC teams throughout solution design, transition and stabilization. Prepare and maintain comprehensive solution and transition documentation, including scope and process maps, target operating model, organization design, resource and capacity plans, RACI, assumptions, dependencies, business case inputs, implementation plans and governance packs. Own end-to-end transitions of process scope from regions into the GSC, from initiation and due diligence through planning, knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live, stabilization and formal handover to operations. Define transition objectives, in-scope / out-of-scope activities, success measures, milestones, deliverables and acceptance criteria jointly with stakeholders and receiving operations teams. Develop and manage integrated transition plans covering resourcing, hiring and onboarding, knowledge transfer, training, access and technology readiness, controls, documentation, communications and operational readiness. Establish and govern structured transition toll gates with clear entry / exit criteria and evidence-based readiness assessments; ensure appropriate stakeholder sign-offs before progression and go-live. Maintain robust RAID management, proactively identifying risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies; define mitigants, owners and escalation paths and drive timely resolution of roadblocks. Lead transition governance and stakeholder reporting, tracking milestones, actions, decisions, readiness and overall transition health; escalate material risks or deviations with clear recommendations and recovery plans. Manage go-live and stabilization / hypercare, monitor agreed service and quality indicators, close residual risks and actions, capture lessons learned and complete a structured handover to business-as-usual operations. 
 Skills & Competencies Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with significant hands-on experience in transition management, solutioning, shared services / GSC, BPO or offshoring environments. Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional transitions is essential. Strong knowledge of transition and solutioning frameworks, target operating model and organization design, capacity / resource planning, governance, toll-gate methodology, risk management, process migration and operational readiness. Strong analytical, structured problem-solving and commercial mindset, with the ability to convert ambiguous requirements into executable solutions and transition plans. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills, with confidence engaging independently with senior leaders across regions and functions. Strong project and program management capability, including governance, milestone management, RAID management, executive reporting and management of multiple concurrent transitions. Demonstrated ownership, judgement and decision-making ability; comfortable challenging constructively, managing competing priorities and driving outcomes in a matrixed, multicultural environment.  About the Role We are looking for a Customer Support Executive who enjoys interacting with customers, solving problems and helping people find the right solutions. This role will handle the complete customer journey - from pre-sales enquiries and order assistance to post-sales support and follow-ups . The role involves both inbound and outbound calls, customer conversations, sales support and coordination with internal teams . Since MrMed deals with specialty medicines, the role also requires the ability to understand and learn about prescription requirements, specialty medicines and healthcare-related processes . Key Responsibilities Customer Support Handle inbound and outbound calls from customers. Respond to customer queries related to medicines, orders, pricing, availability and delivery. Understand customer concerns and provide timely and appropriate solutions. Handle delayed deliveries, order issues, refunds, cancellations and other post-sales queries with empathy. Follow up with customers and ensure issues are closed properly. Maintain a positive and helpful customer experience throughout the interaction. Sales Pre-Sales Support Understand customer requirements and assist them in placing orders. Handle pre-sales enquiries and support customers in making informed purchase decisions. Follow up with potential customers and pending orders. Support sales conversion through effective customer conversations and follow-ups. Communicate product availability, offers and relevant benefits appropriately. Work towards defined sales and revenue targets. Prescription Specialty Medicine Support Understand and follow the companys processes for prescription-based medicines. Politely explain prescription requirements to customers when applicable. Guide customers on uploading or sharing valid prescriptions. Develop basic knowledge of specialty medicines, medical terminology and healthcare processes. Coordinate with pharmacists and internal teams whenever customer queries require further assistance. Order Issue Resolution Coordinate with Pharmacy, Procurement, Operations, Logistics and Sales teams to resolve customer issues. Track out-of-stock medicines and follow up on availability. Explore possible options as per company guidelines when a required medicine is unavailable. Keep customers informed about order status, availability and expected timelines. Handle customer concerns professionally, even in difficult situations. Customer Experience Listen patiently and understand the customers actual concern. Communicate clearly and empathetically, especially when dealing with patients or their family members. Take ownership of customer issues and ensure proper follow-up. Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, orders and follow-ups. Ensure every interaction leaves the customer feeling heard, supported and cared for. What We re Looking For 1+ year of experience in Customer Support, Inside Sales, Telecalling, Telesales, Customer Experience, Healthcare or E-commerce. Any Graduate. Good verbal communication skills. Comfortable handling both inbound and outbound calls. Customer-friendly, patient and empathetic approach. Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics. Good follow-up and problem-solving skills. Ability to handle multiple conversations/tasks in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to work in rotational shifts, if required. Comfortable learning about medicines, medical terms and healthcare processes. Basic computer skills and familiarity with CRM/order management systems. 
 Why Join MrMed At MrMed, the customer is often someone looking for an important medicine for themselves or their family. Every conversation matters. We are looking for people who bring empathy, ownership, energy and a genuine willingness to help - while also enjoying the excitement of sales and customer interaction. If you enjoy talking to people, solving problems and turning a customer conversation into a positive experience, we would love to meet you.

The position will manage a business volume of approximately 50 Lakhs 1 Crore per month, with 10–15 Salon Managers reporting directly and overall people responsibility of approximately 150–175 employees.

Monitor competitor activities and identify opportunities for business growth. MIS & People Management Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly sales/MIS reports. Analyze sales and competitor performance and take corrective actions. Recruit, coach, motivate, and develop Salon Managers and team members.  COMPANY PROFILE: Green Trends Salons is one of the business in Group Company of CavinKare – a FMCG giant of India (Popular Cavinkare Brands include Chik, Nyle, Meera, Cavin's, Indica, Ruchi, Bhima, Maa, Biker's, Spinz, Garden, Raaga, Bacto V, and many others. title: Senior Crm Manager
description:
Job description: Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Customer Relationship Management 
o Serve as the primary point of contact for high-value clients, ensuring their needs are met and
expectations exceeded.
o Build and maintain long-term relationships to foster trust.
o Create targeted campaigns and initiatives to engage customers, drive usage, and promote loyalty.
o Actively engage with clients to gather feedback and address concerns promptly.
 2. Customer Journey Mapping & Revenue Maximization 
o Map out the end-to-end customer journey to identify touchpoints and opportunities for improvement.
o Identify opportunities for up-selling and cross-selling aligned with the clients goals and company
offerings.
o Develop account strategies to drive business growth and ensure profitability.
o Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to create tailored proposals for clients.
 3. Strategic Planning & Execution 
o Develop and implement customer relationship strategies that align with the organizations objectives.
o Monitor client metrics and KPIs, including satisfaction scores, retention rates, and revenue.
o Creating custom centric programs for client servicing and retentions.
o Anticipate client needs and proactively suggest solutions to address challenges.
o Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of CRM initiatives with product
development, marketing, sales, and support efforts
 4. Team Leadership & Collaboration 
o Mentor and guide junior relationship managers or account executives.
o Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, including product, sales, and customer support, to
deliver seamless client experiences.
o Act as a client advocate during organizational decision-making processes.
 5. Customer Support and Service Excellence 
o Oversee the customer support function to ensure prompt and effective resolution of customer inquiries,
issues, and concerns.
o Implement service level agreements (SLAs) and performance metrics to monitor and improve the quality
of customer support.
o Develop training programs and resources to empower support teams to deliver exceptional service.
 6. Data Analytics, Reporting & Documentation 
o Maintain accurate records of client interactions, contracts, and other relevant details in CRM tools.
o Translate data-driven insights into actionable strategies for enhancing the customer experience
o Prepare and present reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction,
revenue forecasts, retention, and loyalty programs to senior leadership. 
 Qualifications: 
12+ years of experience in customer relationship management, account management, or a similar role, with at least 7+ years in a senior and team handling position is must.
Client facing and having experience in devising strategies for Key Accounts, Large Accounts, Government Accounts.
Traveling across in India for large Account meetings.
Leadership and mentoring capabilities.
Strong Analytical Skills to interpret data and derive actionable insights.
Effective Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present ideas clearly.
Proven experience in Sales and expertise in Market Segmentation to strategize customer engagement and retention.
Project Management skills for implementing CRM projects and streamlining processes.
Experience with CRM platforms like Salesforce and understanding of customer lifecycle management is a plus.
Ability to adapt to dynamic work environments and meet organizational objectives.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Job Description The Escalation Manager is a specialized individual contributor role within the Global Support organization, responsible for owning and managing critical customer account escalations from onset through stabilization and closure. This role acts as the single point of accountability within Support for escalated accounts, ensuring issues are addressed with urgency, structure, and cross-functional alignment. The EM s primary objective is to stabilize high-risk customer accounts by driving the resolution of critical issues, coordinating closely with Support, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Product teams. This includes ensuring proper prioritization of P1 and high-impact cases, enforcing case hygiene, facilitating timely Engineering engagement, and ensuring that internal escalation paths are triggered proactively before the customer or Sales team raises concerns externally. This role requires strong technical depth across ERP application architecture, infrastructure, and troubleshooting. The EM must be able to understand complex technical landscapes, challenge and guide resolution strategies, and hold teams accountable for progress. While not responsible for direct implementation or relationship management, the EM acts as the technical escalation leader for the account, ensuring a coordinated and transparent support response. Beyond day-to-day escalation handling, the Escalation Manager plays a critical role in: Identifying systemic or recurring issues contributing to account instability. Driving and participating in account-level stabilization plans. Engaging in post-escalation reviews to strengthen processes and prevent recurrence. Ensuring clear and structured internal and external communication. This is a high-visibility role requiring composure under pressure, strong cross-functional leadership without formal authority, and the ability to influence outcomes across multiple teams. Given the nature of escalated accounts, the position may require flexible working hours, on-call participation, and direct executive visibility. Escalated Account Ownership: Act as the primary escalation lead for high-impact customer accounts, ensuring structured management of escalations from initiation through stabilization and closure. Drive internal alignment and ensure timely execution of action plans across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, and Product. Stabilization and Resolution Strategy: Develop and execute account-level stabilization plans to address critical issues, reduce ticket volumes, and restore customer confidence. Proactively identify systemic issues contributing to escalations and drive resolution with the right internal stakeholders. Escalation Governance: Ensure proper prioritization, case hygiene, and timely engagement of technical resources for all escalated accounts. Trigger and manage internal escalation paths proactively to avoid external escalations through CSM or Sales. Set customer expectations and provide updates regarding troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer-facing communications. Technical Engagement and Resolution Acceleration: Leverage strong technical knowledge of ERP architecture and infrastructure to guide resolution strategies and validate progress. Collaborate closely with Critical Support team, Tier 2/3 engineers, SMEs, and product teams to remove technical blockers and accelerate resolution timelines. Cross-Functional Coordination and Communication: Coordinate across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, Product Management, and CSM/CSDM teams to ensure alignment and accountability. Deliver clear, structured, and timely communications on escalation status, risks, and next steps to all stakeholders. Feedback Loop and Product Improvement: Partner with CSM/CSDMs and Product Management to share customer feedback, recurring pain points, and systemic issues observed during escalations. Work with Engineering teams to help prioritize critical fixes and influence product stability and supportability improvements. Shift Coverage and Flexibility: Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support. Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers in different time zones. Continuous Improvement and Post-Escalation Review: Lead or contribute to post-escalation reviews to identify root causes, process gaps, and product opportunities. Support implementation of preventive measures to minimize future escalations and strengthen overall support readiness. Collaborate with people managers and business leaders to drive continuous improvement in people, processes, and technology through a closed-loop process by identifying drivers for escalation. Qualifications Education: A Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered. Experience: 5+ years of experience in enterprise product support, technical escalation management, or critical response roles in a SaaS or ERP environment. Demonstrated ability to own and drive critical account escalations, ensuring cross-functional alignment and rapid resolution. Proven experience in working closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to resolve high-impact technical issues. Strong background in ERP systems (such as QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365) with the ability to understand complex technical landscapes and influence resolution strategies. Experience coordinating multiple high-priority issues simultaneously under pressure, with clear accountability and customer focus. Experience leveraging AI tools (such as generative AI assistants, diagnostic copilots, or predictive analytics platforms) to analyze incident data, perform rapid root cause analysis, and identify systemic escalation patterns across ticket histories. Hands-on experience using Jira Service Management and Salesforce Service Cloud to manage critical account escalations, track ticket SLA compliance, enforce case hygiene, and link Tier-3 engineering bugs with customer-facing cases. Background operating within multi-tenant SaaS or hybrid-cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), managing incident workflows involving cloud infrastructure, microservices, database performance, or server deployment issues. Proven track record of driving rapid war-room coordination, real-time stakeholder updates, and post-incident documentation. Technical Skills Strong understanding of enterprise ERP architecture, system integrations, and infrastructure components. Mastery of Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, Slides) for building real-time escalation trackers, publishing root cause analysis (RCA) reports, and delivering executive-ready presentations. Cloud Infrastructure Architecture: Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including cloud infrastructure components, APIs, microservices, containerized environments, and log management tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch). Ability to understand and validate technical resolution paths proposed by Support, Engineering, or Cloud Ops teams. Familiarity with incident and escalation management frameworks and best practices in SaaS or on-prem environments. Preferred / Bonus Qualifications: Prompt Engineering Generative AI Tools: Hands-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, MS Copilot, or custom internal LLMs) for prompt-driven summary generation, ticket sentiment analysis, incident documentation, and automated stakeholder communication drafting. QAD PKS or relevant industry certifications are a plus.

title: Product Support Engineer - Cloud Security
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Product Support Engineer Cloud Security with expertise in Cloud Security, SASE, Zero Trust, and Enterprise Networking technologies. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical support expert and escalation engineer responsible for resolving complex customer issues involving networking, cloud infrastructure, and modern security platforms. This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, customer engagement capabilities, and hands-on experience with cloud security technologies such as Netskope, SASE, ZTNA, CASB, and Zero Trust frameworks. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to drive issue resolution, improve platform stability, and enhance customer experience. 
 Role: Product Support Engineer Cloud Security Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 2 to 8 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Act as the primary technical escalation engineer for critical and high-priority customer issues. Troubleshoot advanced networking, cloud security, and infrastructure-related problems including connectivity, latency, authentication, policy enforcement, and access control issues. Communicate directly with customers through video calls, phone calls, emails, and case management systems. Provide timely customer updates, resolution plans, and technical guidance throughout the support lifecycle. Support and troubleshoot Cloud Security, SASE, Zero Trust, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, and related security platforms. Perform detailed analysis of network traffic using tools such as Wireshark, TCPDump, Netmon, and packet capture utilities. Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, Switching, VPNs, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and Proxy technologies. Support cloud-delivered security solutions including Netskope and similar Secure Service Edge platforms. Troubleshoot SSL/TLS decryption, authentication, SSO, policy enforcement, and secure access issues. Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to identify product defects and drive issue resolution. Participate in root cause analysis and contribute to platform improvements. Support Linux, Unix, Windows, Active Directory, and LDAP environments. Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles. Drive proactive customer success initiatives by identifying potential risks and recommending best practices. Manage support cases and collaborate across teams using Salesforce, Jira, Slack, and other operational tools. Contribute to continuous service improvement and customer experience enhancement initiatives. Stay updated on emerging cloud security threats, technologies, and best practices. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline. 2-8 years of experience in Product Support, Technical Support, Cloud Security, Network Security, or Infrastructure Support roles. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing & Switching, VPNs, Firewalls, and Load Balancing. Hands-on experience troubleshooting enterprise networking and cloud connectivity issues. Strong knowledge of Cloud Security architectures and security best practices. Experience working with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) platforms and architectures. Good understanding of Zero Trust and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts. Hands-on exposure to Netskope or similar cloud security platforms. Working knowledge of CASB, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), SSL/TLS Decryption, DLP, and Cloud Security technologies. Experience supporting network security solutions including NGFW, SSL VPN, IPSec VPN, Proxy Servers, SSO, and Encryption Gateways. Strong experience with Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems. Knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, and Identity & Access Management concepts. Advanced troubleshooting skills using Wireshark, TCPDump, Netmon, Ping, Traceroute, and related diagnostic tools. Experience handling customer escalations and managing critical support cases. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent customer-facing communication and presentation skills. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience collaborating with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Customer Success teams. Familiarity with Salesforce, Jira, Slack, and support workflow management platforms. Strong documentation and technical writing skills. Customer-first mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure support environment.

description:

Handle international clients and leads across different countries, time zones, and geographies. Manage the complete sales cycle independently from initial interaction, qualification, estimation, negotiation, follow-up, and closure. Conduct client meetings, presentations, requirement-gathering sessions, and solution discussions. Understand client business needs and translate them into functional/project requirements for technical teams. Coordinate with technical and delivery teams to understand feasibility, prepare estimations, define timelines, and plan projects. Support project planning, scheduling, execution, monitoring, tracking, and deliverables. Maintain accurate records of client interactions, opportunities, proposals, estimates, and account activities. Coordinate between clients, sales, technology, and delivery teams to ensure smooth communication and project execution. Understand and communicate the value of web development, mobile application development, and open-source solutions. Monitor account performance, project progress, customer requirements, and opportunities for further business. Follow up on opportunities and leads to ensure timely movement toward closure. Work toward achieving sales, revenue, account growth, and customer retention targets. Work extended hours when required to support international clients. 
 What skills and experience are we looking for? 5+ years of experience in customer account management / sales. Mandatory experience in SME / small and medium enterprise business environments. Strong experience in international sales and client account management. Proven experience in up-selling and cross-selling. Experience handling the complete sales cycle, including lead qualification, estimation, negotiation, and closure. Strong consultative selling and customer relationship management skills. Experience conducting client meetings and requirement-gathering sessions. Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills. Strong negotiation, presentation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Good understanding of web development technologies. Good knowledge of open-source technologies and solutions. Good understanding of mobile application development and mobile solutions. Ability to understand technical requirements and coordinate with technical teams. Experience working with technical teams on project estimation and solutioning. Understanding of project planning, scheduling, execution, monitoring, and tracking. Ability to translate business/client requirements into functional requirements for technology teams. Flexibility to work extended hours for international client interactions.

title: IT Helpdesk Intern
description:
IT Helpdesk Intern 
 About FinacPlus FinacPlus is a Great Place to Work Certified organization - a recognition of our people first culture, collaborative environment, and focus on professional growth. We provide high-end virtual business process and technology services to leading global clients across finance, banking, mortgage, research, and data services. At FinacPlus, you ll work with world-class talent, cutting-edge technology, and international stakeholders - while still enjoying the openness, agility, and career visibility of a fast-growing company. 
 About Our Client - Toorak Capital Partners You will be part of a dedicated engineering team supporting Toorak Capital Partners, a leading U.S.-based integrated correspondent lending platform that funds residential, multifamily, and mixed-use real estate loans across the U.S. and U.K. Headquartered in Summit, New Jersey, Toorak s leadership team brings deep expertise across real estate lending, capital markets, securitization, asset management, and credit. To date, Toorak-funded projects have renovated or stabilized housing for 9,000+ families - averaging 500+ families every month.This is a rare opportunity to build mission-critical, cloud-based mortgage technology platforms that directly support one of the most respected players in the global mortgage finance industry. 
 About the Role We are looking for an enthusiastic and customer-focused IT Helpdesk Intern to join our global IT support team. The role will involve providing technical assistance to users across different regions, including the US, UK and India. This is an entry-level opportunity for candidates who have good IT fundamentals, excellent English communication skills, and a strong willingness to learn and build a career in IT Support and Infrastructure. 
 Key Responsibilities Provide first-level technical support to global users through phone, email, chat, remote support tools, and ticketing systems. Troubleshoot common issues related to Windows Mac laptops, desktops, mobile devices, applications, printers, and operating systems. Assist users with password resets, account lockouts, software installation, basic system configuration, and access-related issues. Provide basic support for Active Directory, including user accounts, password resets, account unlocks, and group membership under guidance. Troubleshoot basic network issues related to Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, IP addresses, DNS, DHCP, and VPN. Provide basic support for Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint. Assist with laptop/device setup, software installation, patching, and basic endpoint configuration. Use IT support, RMM, and endpoint management tools to monitor and troubleshoot user devices. Create and maintain accurate tickets, work logs, incident details, and troubleshooting notes. Follow documented troubleshooting procedures and escalate complex issues to senior IT engineers. Maintain and update IT documentation, knowledge-based articles, and user guides. Communicate clearly and professionally with users and provide regular updates on open issues. Follow IT security policies and best practices while handling user accounts, devices, and company information. Participate in a global support environment and work collaboratively with other IT teams. Required Skills Experience Communication Customer Service Excellent spoken and written English communication skills are mandatory. Should be confident speaking with US and UK customers/users over phone and remote support sessions. Ability to understand user problems, ask the right questions, and explain technical solutions in simple language. Strong customer-service mindset with a professional and patient approach. Ability to communicate clearly with users even when handling technical or urgent issues. Good listening skills and ability to document issues accurately. Technical Skills 0-1 year of experience in IT Helpdesk, Technical Support, Desktop Support, or IT internship. Basic understanding of Windows operating systems Mac. Basic knowledge of Active Directory, users, groups, passwords, and account lockouts. Basic understanding of networking concepts such as IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN, and connectivity troubleshooting. Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint. Basic understanding of computer hardware and laptop/desktop troubleshooting. Exposure to ticketing systems, remote support tools, or ITSM tools is an advantage. Basic understanding of endpoint security, antivirus, patching, and security best practices. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset. Willingness and ability to learn new IT technologies and tools. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Basic exposure to Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune or other endpoint management tools. Exposure to RMM tools such as Atera, ConnectWise, or similar platforms. Basic PowerShell or scripting knowledge. Basic understanding of Windows Server environments. Familiarity with ITIL/ITSM concepts. CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft Fundamentals, or equivalent IT certifications/training. Why Join FinacPlus Great Place to Work Certified - strong, collaborative culture Work on enterprise-grade global IT environments Exposure to US UK financial platforms and operations Opportunity to build deep infra + support expertise Clear growth path into L3 / System Engineering / Cloud roles 
 Only Immediate Joiners can apply. Candidates who are currently serving their notice period with 15 days or less remaining are also eligible to apply. 
 Experience: 0-1 Year Location: Bangalore, On site - Manyata Tech Park Shift: 24/7 Rotational Shifts - Candidates must be comfortable working night shifts Timings: 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM IST Duration: 6 months Stipend: 50,000/-Per Month 
 

 Disclaimer: This job posting and location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

title: Associate Information Security Consultant
description:
Role & responsibilities : 
 Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web, mobile, API, network and application environments. Conduct Web Application, Mobile Application and API Security Testing . Perform Black Box and Grey Box Security Testing . Conduct vulnerability assessments and identify security vulnerabilities using appropriate tools and methodologies. Perform Network and Application Security Assessments . Use security tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit and Acunetix . Perform basic Source Code Review and provide security recommendations. Identify, validate and document security vulnerabilities. Prepare security assessment reports with findings, risk ratings and recommendations. Support security testing and automation using open-source tools. Follow OWASP guidelines and industry-standard security testing methodologies.

 Education: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity or related streams . Master's candidates: MCA, M.Sc., M.E. or M.Tech in relevant streams will also be considered. Experience: 01 year; Freshers with relevant internship/project exposure are welcome. CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) Mandatory. Basic understanding of Networking, Cybersecurity, Information Security and VAPT concepts. Exposure to Web, Mobile and API Security Testing will be preferred. Knowledge of Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit and OWASP will be an added advantage. Bug Bounty / Hall of Fame recognition will be an added advantage. Good analytical, verbal and written communication skills. Candidates from Mumbai Region and Pune will be preferred. Immediate joiners only.

 Immediate Joiners Only

title: Tech Lead ( Node.js, Typescript, MongoDB) @ Indexnine Technologies
description:
Position: Technical Lead / Engineering Manager 
 Experience: 8-12 Years 
 Location: Pune 
 Job Description: 
 We are seeking a highly experienced and driven Technical Lead with strong backend development expertise, especially in Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB. The ideal candidate should be technically sound, cloud-savvy (preferably in AWS or Azure), and capable of leading development teams while contributing as a hands-on individual contributor. This role is ideal for candidates operating at or near Architect-level proficiency, with a strong foundation in backend systems 
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead the design, development, and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using Node.js and TypeScript. Architect solutions with clean code practices, high availability, and performance at scale. Drive the adoption of modern development frameworks, patterns, and tools across the team. 
 Mentor and guide a team of engineers while also contributing directly to code and architecture. Collaborate with product managers, QA teams, and DevOps to ensure seamless delivery and deployment. Define and maintain API structures, data models, and service integration strategies. Handle backend performance tuning, cloud deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Champion best practices in backend development, code reviews, and team processes 
 Requirements: 
 8 to 12 years of total experience in backend development. Strong hands-on experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB. Proven experience with at least one cloud platform preferably AWS or Azure. Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and system design principles. Strong problem-solving skills with a passion for scalable, high-quality backend architecture. Experience working both as an individual contributor and as a team lead. Excellent communication, leadership, and mentoring skills 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Candidates with experience close to an Architect-level profile. Backend-focused professionals frontend-heavy experience is not preferred. Exposure to containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices is a plus. Proven Experience in Leading and Mentoring Teams 

 Please send the resume on davindr.shah@indexnine.com with below details Current CTC Expected CTC Notice Period 
 Note:- Early Joiners are preferable. 
 Regards, Davindr Shah
